"Heh."
Sharnoth grinned.
The madness in her eyes returned.
"You have finally showed toys worth breaking, Toy King!"

She laughed loudly. Her movements were bound, but even then, she forced herself to move—so much that her bones dislocated, some of her body parts were torn up—and finally, even in this locked space, she gathered a ridiculous amount of Chaos energy and released it all at the same time—black beams, twisting tendrils, storms of color—she did everything she could to plunge the battlefield into Chaos again.
But...
Zarveth raised the lantern.
All possibilities lit up before him.
He chose the one where he dodged everything... perfectly.

Yes, Sharnoth’s chaotic attacks were no longer unpredictable—not when the enemy held the lantern that showed every single possibility out of billions, trillions of them that existed, and highlighted the ones where the enemy just couldn’t lose.
Zarveth blurred forward, appearing in front of her.
And then he struck.
The Blade of Rewriting.
The pen touched her body, and suddenly—
Whoosh

All the Chaos energy present all over the place disappeared as if it never existed. Sharnoth’s crimson eyes shined brightly as she screamed, but no voice came out. Her Body of Chaos began to tremble. The parts of her skin that had already peeled away started to flicker.
The energy within them couldn’t hold.
She tried to lift her arm—it didn’t move.
She tried to blink, but her eyelids wouldn’t obey.
Her body, once wild and shifting, now hovered frozen, as if something important from her was taken away.
Slowly, a red stream of tears fell from her eyes. She could sense it—her end was near. Her life flashed in her mind.

Zarveth stood above her, breathing slowly. With her partial domain gone, nothing threatened him anymore. He could now deal with the woman even without the Infinity Relics—and as if the relics knew that, they floated behind him, dimming as if their purpose was fulfilled.
Now, it was Zarveth’s turn.
With Sharnoth now in his hands, it was time to find out the Anomaly’s secret.
Or at least... that’s what he was going to do... but suddenly...

The silently screaming Sharnoth grinned. The madness in her eyes still didn’t fade away. Her lips cracked open; she said something, but no voice came out. However, Zarveth’s eyes widened when he realized what she was trying to do.
Something that went against the very energy she cultivated.
Those forbidden words...
Zarveth knew them well.
A Dark Spell.
Yes, it was the same Dark Spell Sharnoth’s mother used to try and end herself back then. For an instant, her maddened crimson eyes turned moist.
’A fitting end...’
She muttered inwardly, preparing to end things before Zarveth could stop her. But then—
BOOOOOOM
A dark energy, different from the Dark Spell Sharnoth was evoking, filled the area. An energy both Sharnoth and Zarveth instantly recognized.
It was the same darkness the Anomaly had used to escape.
If the same energy was used, then it meant...
The Anomaly was here.
Zarveth’s smile widened when he realized it, and just as he expected, the moment the dark energy disappeared, he appeared.
His eyes stared at Sharnoth, observing her condition—trapped in a space where her movements were taken away, her connection with Chaos broken, bloodied tears falling from her eyes.
Her physique was a mess. Her skin peeled, her body parts torn, hovering in the same space that bound her, her entire body bloodied.
It was horrifying.

However, what was even more horrifying was that despite her current condition, the woman was still grinning like a maniac—almost as if she no longer had the ability to think straight, even when Nux was standing right in front of her.
And when Nux saw that...
"So in the end—you failed to suppress your true nature, huh?"
He sighed as he pressed his forehead.
"I feared this might happen."

sentences.text: "...those aren’t yours,"
Sharnoth muttered, staring at the six relics that appeared out of nowhere with a solemn look on her face.
It seemed quite strange to look at her serious face when all she had been doing all this while was laughing like a maniac who had lost her mind.
Zarveth, however, instead of feeling strange—
"As I said,
You didn’t leave me any other choice."
He just smiled lightly.
"I must praise you though,
I thought you had lost yourself in your emotions, but you can sense danger even in that state, huh?
Does this mean you didn’t consider me an actual threat till now?"
He questioned curiously.
Even though his own question put him down, he didn’t mind; his curiosity far overwhelmed his sense of shame.
Not to mention, this woman wouldn’t survive for long anyway.
This incident would disintegrate here with her.
"...what are these?"
Sharnoth questioned.
"Shouldn’t you answer my question first?"
Zarveth chuckled.
He could tell that Sharnoth was trying to buy time to complete her Body of Chaos.
However, he could also see that time wasn’t everything she needed.
If that were the case, she would have been a lot stronger than she currently was.
The Body of Chaos was the strongest physique known to the universe.
There was no one who could comprehend it just because they had ’enough time.’
More than time, Sharnoth needed to continue to comprehend Chaos through battle.
Yes, that was what the woman needed—a fight against a being stronger than her, a fight where she could push herself beyond her limits and comprehend the True Chaos.
This was the reason she, who had been Eternal for a long time now, was finally making progress.
She had finally found a being she didn’t have to hold back against.
But if Zarveth stopped trying...?
Sharnoth’s progress would halt again.
Or at least that was Zarveth’s theory, and right now, he was willing to risk it.
After all, he now had the absolute advantage.
"I will answer when you answer."
Sharnoth narrowed her eyes, the Chaos energy around her increasing even now.
Zarveth laughed; he didn’t miss what the woman was trying to do.
"You are correct.
These relics aren’t mine."
Zarveth nodded, deciding to answer Sharnoth’s question.
"They were forged by Lord Infinity himself."
"Lord Infinity...?"
Sharnoth narrowed her eyes, and Zarveth’s grin widened.
"Indeed."
"Can you... use those?"
Suddenly, Sharnoth questioned with a frown on her face.
Zarveth tilted his head and—
"I thought the relics distributed throughout the universe were connected to the Supreme Worlds.
Shouldn’t it be the same for the relics given to you by the Infinity?
Using those relics..."
"Lord Infinity would find out about our battle."
Zarveth completed the woman’s words, and Sharnoth frowned.
Did he really want Lord Infinity to know about them?
But he just betrayed them...
There was no way the Infinities would let him go after this.
His past actions had all been trying to hide from the Infinities and learn the Anomaly’s secrets.
Then why...
"You underestimate him."
Suddenly, Zarveth spoke up, attracting Sharnoth’s attention.
"He is connected to every relic that is created inside the Supreme World of Eternity.
Because I share his blood, it doesn’t matter if I create my relics on my own.
If he ever desires it, my relics will become his.
If he wishes to observe me, he doesn’t have to use the relics he gave to me.
He can connect through any relic present in the universe and observe any being he wishes."
He revealed.
"Then why..."
Sharnoth frowned as more and more questions appeared in her head.
"He simply does not bother."
Zarveth frowned.
"According to him, we were sent to deal with mere mercenaries.
He wouldn’t waste his time keeping an eye on us.
Even if I use his relics, as long as I do not spend too much time, everything will be fine."
"Then why didn’t you use these relics before?"
Sharnoth asked another question.
"I didn’t feel the need to."
Zarveth answered honestly.
Then, his grin widened and—
"It wouldn’t have been fun if I defeated you before you could show me all this, wouldn’t it?"
"You sound confident, quite different from how you were acting before."
"Aren’t you the same?
I’m not hearing that crazy laughter anymore."
Zarveth chuckled and suddenly—
"Is that so?"
Sharnoth grinned as well.
This time, however, her grin did not affect Zarveth.
Rather—
"For billions of years, I worked harder than anyone to get these relics in hopes to use them against beings who I feel threatened by to change the tides of battle,
But by the time I got these, I reached a level where very few could challenge me and make me use them.
Today, however, is different."
He began, as he then looked into Sharnoth’s eyes and—
"Congratulations,
You have become one of the beings who successfully managed to make me feel threatened.
For a mere hundred-thousand-year-old Eternal, it is something you can boast about for the rest of your reincarnations."
He declared, as suddenly—

Another was a pen-like blade that could rewrite anything it touched.
A cube of silence, that erased sound, thought, and will.
A key, that unlocked the structure of time and bent it in favor of the wielder.
A lantern, that showed all possibilities at once.
And at the center—the Crest of Chronos, the true mark of the Eternal Infinity.
As they lit up, the space around Zarveth changed.
Different energies that seemed chaotic started realigning.
Time stabilized.
Space strengthened.
All other Primordial Energies found a balance they had initially lost and—
Chaos was... pushed back.
"That’s not fair."
Sharnoth pouted, her grin, however, did not fade away.
Rather, it only widened.
She wanted to see it; she wanted to peek into the strength of an Infinity!
"It never was."

The Chaos that made it difficult for his relics to work properly no longer seemed to bother him.

chapters.title: Chapter 2108: You disappoint me, Sharnoth Nocthys.
paragraphs: "So in the end—you failed to suppress your true nature, huh?"
Nux sighed as he pressed his forehead, appearing right in front of Sharnoth, who couldn’t be in any worse condition.

Her body was in agony, a soul-shaking agony. Her crimson tears were proof of that, and Nux could predict it. He could see how her connection to Chaos was severed. For a being of Chaos, it was similar to twisting her body inside out.
The pain...
It was unimaginable.
Her torn limbs didn’t even look like a big deal compared to what she was going through right now. Honestly, any normal being in her place would have already been on their knees, completely broken.
Yet...
The woman was still laughing.
It was horrifying.
"I feared this might happen."
Nux muttered lightly, sighing without stop.
Sharnoth grinned as she stared at him.
No voice came out of her mouth because of the restrictions placed on her, but Nux didn’t need to hear her voice to know what she was saying.
’Did you really?’
He just looked at her and—
"Nah."
He laughed.
’You must have wanted to see me like this, didn’t you?’
"I wanted to play with you.
I wanted to play with therealSharnoth Nocthys, not the Sharnoth you became to please those around you."
He laughed. The crazy shine in his eyes matched Sharnoth’s. The two looked as if they were made for each other.
In his mind, Nux started recalling Sharnoth’s memories he had seen before.
It was around the time Sharnoth had absorbed the Chaos Crystal Zylarith had given her, fundamentally changing her body and making her used to the Energy of Chaos.

Now, the Energy of Chaos was without a doubt one of the strongest energies in the Universe. Its nature was wild and unpredictable. Being forcefully made to connect with this energy came with its own... disadvantages.
It changed the wielder’s very personality, making it similar to its own nature: wild and unpredictable.
Or...
A crazy maniac.
Sharnoth was no exception. During her initial days of training, things were still under control. However, as soon as she began using her Energy of Chaos in battles, it started affecting her.
She became Chaos Incarnate. What made sense... did not in her case.

Pain didn’t stop or scare her; it made her fiercer, happier. A one-sided match where she won became boring. A wild, unpredictable battle where she couldn’t win made her stronger. Laughing at those who were stronger than her made her relish in excitement.
A warrior who was impossibly persistent and ridiculously strong, someone who would rush to her death in excitement and defeat the inevitable death.
That was who she was, until...
Zylarith stopped her.
"If you want your revenge, you need to suppress yourself."
Those were her mentor’s words.
Sure, a crazy, suicidal maniac who loved defying odds and death was powerful, but someone like that wasn’t meant to become a leader.
Rather, she was someone destined to be short-lived, eventually losing her battle against death, and Zylarith could not allow it.
So he suppressed her, telling her to hide her true self from the entire Universe until her fake self became her true self, and her true self... disappeared.
A self that only Zylarith—and later Nux, who witnessed it himself—knew about.
A self that... attracted Nux to her even more.
’I wanted to play with you too.’

Sharnoth answered. She could already see her end was here. She had even begun chanting Dark Spells, even though she had stopped because she wanted to meet and talk to Nux for the first time. The aftereffects of this already pushed her body beyond anything that could be repaired. That was simply how powerful the Dark Spells were.
’But it seems I couldn’t defeat fate this time.’
She sighed,
’But I won! That bastard cheated!’
Of course, she still didn’t give in.
’If I knew, I wouldn’t hav—’
"Wow~
I didn’t think you, of all people, would give an excuse."
Nux laughed.
’It is not an excuse!!’
Sharnoth countered. Despite her body being in agonizing pain, her eyes looked fiercer than ever, as if she was ready to fight and stand against Nux if she could.
"Tsk tsk, it is an excuse."
Nux didn’t give in.
Teasing her was fun.
’It is not!! I would have defe—’
Sharnoth tried to answer, but then—
"Then how about I give you another chance?"
’...what?’
Sharnoth blinked.
Soon, however, her eyes widened in horror—
’No! DON’T!!!’

She tried to shout, but no voice came out. Nux didn’t listen and extended his hand forward to grab the Blade of Rewriting that had pierced through her core—a sight that made Zarveth’s eyes shine in excitement.

The moment the Anomaly appeared, he had been thinking about how to deal with him, since he did seem like a tricky opponent considering the fact that he managed to fend off Neremoth and return here so quickly.

Clearly, defeating the Anomaly wasn’t the problem. He had quite a few tricks, but in the end, he was what he was—a Primordial. The difference of two Phases was simply impossible to surpass. Heck, even a single Phase difference can never be surpassed.
It had never happened in the history of the Universe.
Even Lord Zylarith, with his complete Body of Chaos, couldn’t do that.
What worried Zarveth more was the fact that once the Anomaly realized this, he would disappear like he did before.
He needed a way to stop him.
Clearly, sealing the Space didn’t work, seeing as how he was able to travel in and out of this sealed space as if it was nothing. He needed something else.
And he needed to do it without him realizing it.
While Zarveth was thinking of a way, he saw the Anomaly touching the Blade of Rewriting on his own, and he grinned.

He was obviously still connected to the Blade of Rewriting, and since the pen only needed physical contact to work, the instant the Anomaly touched it, he could sever his connection with his Law—no matter what it was—taking away all his strange abilities and getting his hands on him.

Sure, the action would reconnect that woman with the Energy of Chaos, but her current condition was already a mess. She would need time to once again return to a fighting state, and that time, even if it was less than a second, would be more than enough for him to capture the Anomaly.
The plan was made.

With the Infinity Relics, the battle would end before it could even begin. Heck, Zarveth had already planned how he was going to extract all the information he needed, and the more he thought about the new world of knowledge he was going to explore, the more excited he became.

He stared intently as the Anomaly’s hand moved towards the Blade of Rewriting, completely unaware of what fate awaited him. He prepared his connection to react instantly, not giving him any time to dodge.
And just when the Anomaly grabbed the Blade of Rewriting, Zarveth rewrote his very—
Crack
Zarveth froze.
Crack Crack Crack
Shatter
Right in front of his very eyes, the Blade of Rewriting, one of the six Infinity Relics, one of the strongest Relics in the entirety of the Universe... was crushed into pieces.
Zarveth couldn’t believe it.
A Relic shattering...
It was an extremely rare sight.
The reason Eternity Relics were so widely used was because their build quality was beyond what anyone in this entire Universe could copy.
Even the lowest-level Relics were much, much stronger than anything beings all over the Universe could create.

There was simply no competition. The materials Eternity used were the strongest. Their technology made their creations even stronger. It was something they had been doing and improving for trillions and trillions of years, allowing them to create what could be called God’s Weapons—weapons that single-handedly changed the outcome of a battle.
Weapons that allowed them to control the rest of the Universe. Weapons that made it such that even without Authority, they had what it took to stand side by side with other Supreme Worlds.
This was the legacy of Relics.
Weapons that... simply did not break.
Even the Relics Zarveth created—the ones he used in his battle against Sharnoth—yes, many of his Relics became unusable, some of them even cracked, but that was it.
None of the Relics had truly shattered. Within a day or two, most of them would be back to their best condition, repairing themselves on their own.
And the Infinity Relics were obviously far better than his own creations. Let alone breaking—he had never seen even a slight scratch appear on them. Yet...
But the Blade of Rewriting...
Zarveth could feel it.
His connection with it no longer existed. The Blade of Rewriting was truly destroyed.
And Nux...
From start to finish, he didn’t spare a single glance to Zarveth and chuckled at Sharnoth instead.
"Tsk tsk, I can’t believe you were defeated by this toy."
He spoke, showing what was left of the crushed Infinity Relic in his hand.
"You disappoint me, Sharnoth Nocthys."

He prepared his connection to react instantly, not giving him any time to dodge.
And just when the Anomaly grabbed the Blade of Rewriting, Zarveth rewrote his very—
Crack
Zarveth froze.
Crack Crack Crack
Shatter
Right in front of his very eyes, the Blade of Rewriting, one of the six Infinity Relics, one of the strongest Relics in the entirety of the Universe... was crushed into pieces.
Zarveth couldn’t believe it.
A Relic shattering...
It was an extremely rare sight.
The reason Eternity Relics were so widely used was because their build quality was beyond what anyone in this entire Universe could copy.
Even the lowest-level Relics were much, much stronger than anything beings all over the Universe could create.
There was simply no competition.
The materials Eternity used were the strongest.
Their technology made their creations even stronger.

It was something they had been doing and improving for trillions and trillions of years, allowing them to create what could be called God’s Weapons—weapons that single-handedly changed the outcome of a battle.
Weapons that allowed them to control the rest of the Universe.
Weapons that made it such that even without Authority, they had what it took to stand side by side with other Supreme Worlds.
This was the legacy of Relics.
Weapons that... simply did not break.
Even the Relics Zarveth created—the ones he used in his battle against Sharnoth—yes, many of his Relics became unusable, some of them even cracked, but that was it.
None of the Relics had truly shattered.
Within a day or two, most of them would be back to their best condition, repairing themselves on their own.
And the Infinity Relics were obviously far better than his own creations.
Let alone breaking—he had never seen even a slight scratch appear on them.
Yet...
But the Blade of Rewriting...
Zarveth could feel it.
His connection with it no longer existed.
The Blade of Rewriting was truly destroyed.
And Nux...
From start to finish, he didn’t spare a single glance to Zarveth and chuckled at Sharnoth instead.
"Tsk tsk, I can’t believe you were defeated by this toy."
He spoke, showing what was left of the crushed Infinity Relic in his hand.
"You disappoint me, Sharnoth Nocthys."

chapters.title: Chapter 2109: What have you done...?
paragraphs: "Tsk tsk, I can’t believe you were defeated by this toy."
Nux spoke, showing what was left of the crushed Infinity Relic in his hand as he dramatically shook his head in disappointment.
"You disappoint me, Sharnoth Nocthys."
He sighed, and Sharnoth...
She just couldn’t believe what she was seeing. Her connection with the Energy of Chaos was restored; however, this did her more harm than good.
Sharnoth had the Body of Chaos. It was incomplete, sure, but her very being represented Chaos. However, the Dark Spell she used was connected to the Power of Darkness—an Energy different from Chaos.

She could use it when her connection with Chaos was cut off; however, now that that connection was restored, the Energy of Chaos and the lingering Energy of Darkness clashed against each other inside her body.
And the result?
’AAAAAAGGGGGGHHHHHHHHHH!!!’

Sharnoth screamed in agony as the two energies crushed her insides. What’s worse was that this pain was never-ending. Her body was made of Chaos—more Chaotic Energy around her, the quicker she would regenerate—so her insides were being regenerated, then destroyed, then regenerated only to be destroyed again and again and again.
The pain was agonizing, something that could make any being lose his or her mind.
But...
Not Sharnoth.
She had long lost her mind before all this pain. Rather, once she got used to the pain, she glanced at Nux, her crimson eyes shining with powerful excitement and—
’How did you do that?’
She questioned, staring at the pieces of Infinity Relic in his hands.
"What do you mean how? It is because I am obviously stronger than you."
Nux snorted in disdain.
’You think you are stronger than me???’
Sharnoth questioned back, her crimson eyes now shining even more brightly. It was almost threatening. Any sane person would feel goosebumps if he ever saw that expression, but Nux?
He just grinned.
"Think? I know I am stronger than you."
He then looked at Sharnoth’s detached limbs and—
"You can’t even heal, move, or speak because you are bound by some toy."
He sighed, looking for the toy that did all this to his Sharnoth, and soon, his eyes fell on a silver-colored cube and—
He extended his hand towards it, almost as if trying to call it towards him.
A sight that both horrified and humiliated Zarveth.
The Cube of Silence was floating right behind him, but this man... he didn’t even look at him while he conversed leisurely with that woman!
Does he think that he doesn’t exist!?

Zarveth’s hollow eyes flared with anger when he felt a certain force moving the Cube towards the Anomaly. He quickly regained control over his Cube, putting it behind him again and then glared at the Anomaly.
"You think I will let yo—"
Shatter
Before the Eternity Eternal could even say anything, he heard a voice. A voice that horrified him came from behind.
He slowly turned around and saw the Anomaly standing behind him. In his hand was... another Infinity Relic... completely shattered.
Zarveth’s entire body froze when he sensed his connection with the Cube of Silence being erased as well.
"How!? You were just there—"
He quickly turned around again, looking at where the Anomaly was once standing, and there, his eyes fell on the Anomaly, still with his hand extended forward, as if calling the cube.
When the Anomaly’s eyes fell on him, he turned towards that woman and—
"Now I am even more disappointed in you, Sharnoth Nocthys. To think you lost against someone who can’t even differentiate between an illusion and reality.
Tsk tsk tsk."

He snorted as suddenly, his body began to flicker out of existence, as if its purpose was solved, and behind Sharnoth, another Anomaly appeared. In his hands were the remains of the Cube of Silence that he had just destroyed.
"H-How—"
Zarveth couldn’t believe it. He looked back, trying to find the Anomaly that was just standing behind him, but he couldn’t see him.
The Anomaly had teleported!
In the space where Space Laws don’t even exist, that monster teleported!
How!?
HOW CAN THIS HAPPEN!?
He didn’t even sense the Power of Space being used!?
What was happening!?
Why was nothing making any sense!?
What’s more...
"HE WAS STRONGER WHEN HE WAS FIGHTING ME!!"
The woman shouted, her maddened eyes glaring at Zarveth in anger she didn’t show before.
"OI!! FIGHT HIM PROPERLY!
WHAT ARE YOU ACTING LIKE A FOOL FOR!?"
She shouted. It almost seemed like she was the angry coach of a defeated athlete who wasn’t giving his best.
And Nux...
"Just admit it, Sharnoth, all of these are just excuses. You lost to someone so pathati—"
He tried to tease further, but suddenly—
"I DIDN’T LOSE TO HIM!!
HE BECAME WEAKER!!"
Sharnoth shouted as she jumped onto Nux before even recovering.
Yes, the unpredictable woman was now attacking Nux.
Zarveth stared at this odd situation with a stupefied look on his face.
The Eternity Eternal had no clue what was happening.
Weren’t these two allies?
Then why was that woman attacking the Anomaly?

As someone who had faced the woman before, he could also tell she wasn’t holding back at all. If anything, she was overexerting herself, trying to hurt the Anomaly. The Partial Domain that was destroyed before had started reforming as well.

Of course, as much as everything happening surprised him, Zarveth didn’t miss this odd chance he had received. With the Anomaly busy with that crazy woman who had started attacking him out of nowhere, Zarveth could now do anything he wanted.
He could escape, come up with a plan to deal with this situation, call for reinforcements, or...
He could even prepare an attack large enough to take both of them down.
Yes, the situation had completely turned in his favor because of Sharnoth’s unpredictable movements.

This was also the reason Zylarith made Sharnoth suppress her nature. There was no way someone as unstable as her, no matter how strong, would have been able to run an entire World. Zylarith needed her to calm down and think logically in order to fulfill his goals.
As for Nux...
To him, it didn’t matter.
Rather, he was the opposite. The crazier the woman, the more it attracted him. Even now, as Sharnoth unleashed the series of her attacks on him, he faced everything with a big smile on his face.
A smile that matched the smile on Sharnoth’s face.
It almost seemed like two twins were fighting each other.

But of course, unlike Sharnoth, he didn’t get completely lost in the situation. Rather, he suddenly appeared in front of Sharnoth, who was in the middle of unleashing another series of attacks, and grabbed her by her neck, lifting her in the air.
"Unhand me!!"
Sharnoth shouted, constantly moving her arms and legs to try and free herself from Nux, but...
In front of his physical might, there was only so much she could do.
"We will play later, I have something to do."
He spoke.
Obviously, Sharnoth didn’t stop and continued attacking him, and Nux just shrugged. With a crazy woman constantly attacking him with her little limbs, he finally turned towards Zarveth and—
"You and Neremoth—who amongst you is stronger?"
He asked a question.
"What did you do to him?"

Zarveth narrowed his eyes, still secretly creating an attack combination as he questioned back. He no longer underestimated his opponent, coming up with the strongest possible attack combination in order to capture the Anomaly alive.
Nux just sighed. He could tell that Zarveth was trying to buy time, but...
With the maddened beauty now getting impatient, he didn’t exactly have the luxury to wait.
"Whatever, not that it matters."
He shrugged as suddenly,
"I suppose I should try it."
He slowly extended his free hand outward. A faint ripple formed around his palm. It started small, almost invisible, but quickly expanded, forming a visible sphere of distortion around him.
Zarveth narrowed his eyes.
His instincts started warning him, telling him to escape,
But it was already too late.
Suddenly, the ripple exploded outward.
It spread rapidly in every direction. In seconds, the familiar backdrop of stars, distant planets, and the endless darkness of the Main Universe vanished, replaced by something entirely different.
It was still space, still endless and infinite—but different in a fundamental way.
The distant galaxies, the nebulae, and even the flow of cosmic energy were unlike anything Zarveth had ever sensed.

The stars that appeared were brighter and sharper, shining brilliantly with colors that didn’t exist in the Main Universe—rich purples, intense blues, vivid reds. Nebulae glowed vibrantly, their forms shifting gently as though alive, dancing in slow motion.
Zarveth watched carefully as reality itself changed around him. Even the laws governing this space felt completely foreign.
He tried to spread his own senses, trying to connect to the place around him and understand where exactly he was, but...
He soon realized that he did not recognize this place, which in itself was odd because he knew every single place in the Universe.
It almost felt like...
He was no longer inside the Universe...
"What have you done...?"
He questioned, narrowing his eyes as he felt like his senses were playing with him.
"Nothing, I just created my Domain.
After all, I broke through and became a Transcendent now."

chapters.title: Chapter 2110: Suuurrreeee. I believe you.
paragraphs: "What have you done...?"
Zarveth questioned, narrowing his eyes as he felt like his senses were playing with him, and Nux...
He just chuckled.
"Nothing, I just created my Domain.
After all, I broke through and became a Transcendent now."
"A... Transcendent...?"
Zarveth tilted his head in confusion.
"Well, I am not exactly a Transcendent, but it would be difficult to explain everything to someone like you. You won’t understand."
Nux shook his head.
"I... won’t understand...?"
Zarveth questioned, almost as if he couldn’t even comprehend the notion of not being able to understand something.
And how could he?
Zarveth was a being who had chased knowledge for billions and billions of years, he was already at his peak before most beings in the Universe were even born.
And...
To think someone was now coming to him, telling him that hewon’t understand. It was a completely ridiculous notion.
But what’s worse was that Zarveth could tell that the Anomaly wasn’t lying or trying to rile him up.
This man...
He was telling the truth.
Or at least he believed he was telling the truth.
He truly believed that one of the wisest Eternals of the Supreme World of Eternity, someone who knew almost everything there was to know about the Universe, wouldn’t understand his answer.
It...
It offended Zarveth.
"Try explaining to me, I might surprise you."
He spoke.
It wasn’t a challenge or an order.
It was...
It was a request.
Zarveth truly wanted to know, not just because he was curious or that he craved knowledge, he wanted to prove it to the man who doubted him.
For a reason he couldn’t explain, he felt a strange impulse to prove himself to the man in front of him.
But Nux...
"Meh, it doesn’t really matter."
He shook his head and shrugged carelessly.
"What do you mean?"
Zarveth narrowed his eyes.
"It would be pointless to try and explain myself to someone who would be dying very quickly. It is a waste of effort."
"What...?"
The Supreme Being of Eternity clenched his fists, but Nux just looked into his hollow eyes and—
"What? You hurt my crazy little thing, you didn’t think there would be no consequences, did you?"
His grin turned demonic, his golden eyes shining intensely, almost as if he was prepared to devour this man and end his existence right here and then.
For an instant, Zarveth stepped back.
Intimidation.
Intimidation he only felt when he was in the presence of an Infinity.
’W-What...?’

For a moment, he froze, unable to comprehend what was happening to him, but before he could get lost in his thoughts, his instincts called out to him, alarming him, telling him to do something or else...
"Aren’t you hurting her as well...?"

Zarveth questioned, staring at how the Anomaly was still holding the woman by her neck while she tried to free herself from his hold and attack him. Not once did the woman look or assess the surroundings that had completely changed.
She only cared about freeing herself and attacking this arrogant man in front of her and proving her strength.
"I can do that."
Nux answered directly.
"You cannot."
"That is unreasonable."
Zarveth spoke directly.
"I do not have to be reasonable.
Do you know why?"
Nux grinned.
"Because you believe you are strong."
Zarveth answered.
"Incorrect."
Nux shook his head.
"I do notbelieveI am strong.
Iamstrong."
Nux declared, staring at Zarveth in absolute disdain,
"Much stronger than a being who relies on toys to battle."
"Toys, huh?
Allow me to show you how strong thesetoysare.
As I thought before, forcefully extracting all the answers I need is indeed the best way to deal with the likes of you."
Zarveth spoke arrogantly as the Relics behind him shined. Two of his strongest relics—the Cube of Silence and the Blade of Rewriting—were already destroyed.
But that did not matter.
Not right now. For now, he needed to focus on what he had. He glanced at his remaining four Relics,
The Mirror of Future Victory,
The Lantern of Infinite Paths,
The Chronos Key,
And the Crest of Eternity, the core relic bound to the very concept of Time.
These relics were priceless. They could easily be called a few of the strongest Relics throughout the Universe, but here... they trembled.
He felt like his connection to them in this place was weakening as time passed. Therefore, Zarveth acted quickly.
Light burst from his side—geometric patterns, time loops, and endless futures folding upon one another.
"Let’s end this."
He declared as he made the first move.

His body blurred forward, Chronos Key flaring at his side. The Space around him bent, Time split, and before anyone could react to it, he aimed for Nux’s neck, a blade condensed in his hand, ready to sever Nux’s head.

Well, at least that was what Zarveth thought would have happened, considering he had used the power of both Space and Time here, making it almost impossible to react to his move. And seeing as how Nux couldn’t even follow his movement and react to it, that did seem to be the case but—
Just as his blade was about to touch Nux’s neck, he raised it with his left hand and caught the blade with two fingers.
Then—
Crack
The weapon cracked.
"Impossible—"
Zarveth’s eyes widened.
But this was only the beginning.
Shatter
Nux closed his fingers and the blade shattered like glass.
Zarveth jumped back and instantly activated the Lantern of Infinite Paths. The relic floated above him and displayed all possible moves—defense, offense, retreat, misdirection.
He picked the best one.
The safest one.
But still—
Nux was there first.
As if he too had seen all the possibilities and knew what Zarveth was going to choose.
Touch
With a casual, almost effortless movement, Nux gently placed his palm on Zarveth’s chest, and—
BOOOOOOOOOM
The impact felt like an entire planet had fallen on Zarveth’s body, crushing his body as he flew back like a meteor, smashing layers of asteroids that weren’t there before.
"OI!! FIGHT ME TOO!!"

And during all this movement, never once did Nux let Sharnoth go. Yes, he was holding her by her neck even now, and the Heir of Chaos was absolutely helpless about it. No matter what she did, no matter how many times she tried to attack him with Chaos Energy, it simply didn’t do anything to him.
"Hmm? You are even weaker than him. What’s fun about fighting you?"
Nux just shrugged. He even wiggled Sharnoth’s body as if she were a ragdoll, showing her how truly helpless she was.
"I AM NOT WEAKER THAN HIM!!!"
Sharnoth screamed.
"Suuurrreeee. I believe you."
Nux replied sarcastically.

"I do not have to be reasonable.
Do you know why?"
Nux grinned.
"Because you believe you are strong."
Zarveth answered.
"Incorrect."
Nux shook his head.
"I do notbelieveI am strong.
Iamstrong."
Nux declared, staring at Zarveth in absolute disdain,
"Much stronger than a being who relies on toys to battle."
"Toys, huh?
Allow me to show you how strong thesetoysare.
As I thought before, forcefully extracting all the answers I need is indeed the best way to deal with the likes of you."
Zarveth spoke arrogantly as the Relics behind him shined.
Two of his strongest relics—the Cube of Silence and the Blade of Rewriting—were already destroyed.
But that did not matter.
Not right now.
For now, he needed to focus on what he had.
He glanced at his remaining four Relics,
The Mirror of Future Victory,
The Lantern of Infinite Paths,
The Chronos Key,
And the Crest of Eternity, the core relic bound to the very concept of Time.
These relics were priceless.
They could easily be called a few of the strongest Relics throughout the Universe, but here... they trembled.
He felt like his connection to them in this place was weakening as time passed.
Therefore, Zarveth acted quickly.
Light burst from his side—geometric patterns, time loops, and endless futures folding upon one another.
"Let’s end this."
He declared as he made the first move.
His body blurred forward, Chronos Key flaring at his side.
The Space around him bent, Time split, and before anyone could react to it, he aimed for Nux’s neck, a blade condensed in his hand, ready to sever Nux’s head.
Well, at least that was what Zarveth thought would have happened, considering he had used the power of both Space and Time here, making it almost impossible to react to his move.
And seeing as how Nux couldn’t even follow his movement and react to it, that did seem to be the case but—
Just as his blade was about to touch Nux’s neck, he raised it with his left hand and caught the blade with two fingers.
Then—
Crack
The weapon cracked.
"Impossible—"
Zarveth’s eyes widened.
But this was only the beginning.
Shatter
Nux closed his fingers and the blade shattered like glass.
Zarveth jumped back and instantly activated the Lantern of Infinite Paths.
The relic floated above him and displayed all possible moves—defense, offense, retreat, misdirection.
He picked the best one.
The safest one.
But still—
Nux was there first.
As if he too had seen all the possibilities and knew what Zarveth was going to choose.
Touch
With a casual, almost effortless movement, Nux gently placed his palm on Zarveth’s chest, and—
BOOOOOOOOOM
The impact felt like an entire planet had fallen on Zarveth’s body, crushing his body as he flew back like a meteor, smashing layers of asteroids that weren’t there before.
"OI!!
FIGHT ME TOO!!"
And during all this movement, never once did Nux let Sharnoth go.
Yes, he was holding her by her neck even now, and the Heir of Chaos was absolutely helpless about it.
No matter what she did, no matter how many times she tried to attack him with Chaos Energy, it simply didn’t do anything to him.
"Hmm?
You are even weaker than him.
What’s fun about fighting you?"
Nux just shrugged.
He even wiggled Sharnoth’s body as if she were a ragdoll, showing her how truly helpless she was.
"I AM NOT WEAKER THAN HIM!!!"
Sharnoth screamed.
"Suuurrreeee.
I believe you."
Nux replied sarcastically.

chapters.title: Chapter 2111: Whatever, I guess I will find out on my own.
paragraphs: "I AM NOT WEAKER THAN HIM!!!"
Sharnoth screamed.
"Suuurrreeee. I believe you."
Nux replied sarcastically.
During this conversation, Zarveth stopped himself, panting.

The Mirror of Future Victory glowed brighter now, its silver surface showing a path. A sliver of a future—one chance to land a counterblow since the enemy wasn’t focusing on him, and Zarveth prepared himself.
That was all he needed.
He rushed again.
He attacked, his body phasing between seconds. He struck with the Key, twisting time so that each slash came from both the present and the past.
The mirror showed success.
But as he swung—
Nux moved.
His body did not follow laws of motion, this wasn’t about ’speed’, he was in his Universe, he simply appeared where he ’willed’ himself to appear and—
And his left hand came down.
Zarveth blocked with the Mirror of Future Victory—or at least he tried to, but—
BOOOOOOOM
It shattered like it was made of sand.

Zarveth was thrown down, crashing into another asteroid that appeared out of nowhere. His armor cracked, his blood sprayed all over as his internal organs were shattered and the relic he was so proud of...
Its pieces fell beside him.
Silence.
A heavy silence accompanied him.
He tried to rise, looking at the Lantern of Infinite Paths, but this time...
It didn’t show any path.
As if...
Victory was impossible.
"...even this can’t help me now?"
Zarveth muttered in a low voice, slowly but steadily, his resolve was being crushed.
And in this despair...
Nux was slowly walking toward him while...

"See? I told you. You can’t even move away from me? How can you defeat me? How about you just keep staying next to me instead? Since you are so weak, I will take care of your enemies while you just look pretty for me."
Yes, even now, he wasn’t looking at Zarveth, he...
’That bastard’s flirting with her!!’
Zarveth’s rage took over, he gritted his teeth in anger, the Chronos Key and the Crest of Eternity lit up again.
He screamed, unleashing every technique he had ever learned in all his years. Loops of time, clones from alternate timelines, a spiral of reality collapse, everything he could do, he did.
It all filled the sky.
It looked like a grand, final attack.
And Nux?
He didn’t even bother stopping it.
He let it all hit him.
BOOOOOOOOOM
There was a huge explosion, one that might have given Zarveth a very short-lived hope, but...
Nux simply walked out of the explosion with Sharnoth still in his hands and—
"I AM NOT WEAK!"
"Tsk tsk, why won’t you just admit it?"

—there was absolutely no effect on them. Heck, it didn’t even stop their conversation, Sharnoth continued to attack Nux, more and more of her skin continued to peel off, releasing more and more Chaos Energy while her Body of Chaos became more and more complete, and Nux...
He just allowed it to happen as he walked towards Zarveth.
The Supreme Being of Eternity widened his eyes in horror.
Yes, horror.
This was no longer a fight.
It was an attempt at survival, he realized it, but it was already too late, very very late.
No matter what he did, no matter what he tried,
It just didn’t work.
Time bent around him, but refused to bind him.
Space split, but he remained whole.
Energy twisted, but he remained untouched.

Nux stepped through it all, as if none of his attacks mattered, and finally, as his conversation with Sharnoth momentarily stopped as Sharnoth prepared another attack, Nux turned towards Zarveth and smiled lightly.
"Your toys were fun."
Then, his body disappeared and appeared in front of the Lantern.
Shatter
And he crushed it between his fingers.
One more Infinity Relic—gone.
Zarveth knelt now, coughing blood.
Only two left.
The Key hovered at his side, glowing violently. The Crest of Eternity hummed in panic, its rings spinning faster than ever.
Zarveth looked at Nux, gritting his teeth as he panted heavily.
"You... what are you!?"
Nux raised his eyebrows, then he chuckled,
"As I said, you won’t understand."
He shrugged and then, he disappeared.
Zarveth panicked, but he simply couldn’t react, not when he was inside Nux’s Universe, where everything moved according to his Will.
Nux then appeared behind him, grabbed his shoulder—and crushed the Chronos Key in his hand.
Shatter
Another connection disappeared and Zarveth gasped.
"HAAAHH!!!"
His connection to different timelines was forcefully destroyed and his body felt its toll. His head felt like it was about to burst but...
He didn’t have the time to react to it.
Nux was now standing right in front of him, he tried to back away, holding his only Infinity Relic left, but—
Nux held out his hand—
—and clenched his fist.
BOOOOOOOOOOM
The last Relic shattered into pieces.
And Zarveth’s body, that connected to the Crest of Eternity, collapsed in an instant. His bodily functions stopped, even moving became impossible for him.
"Hmmmm, just as I expected..."
Nux muttered, staring at how Zarveth had collapsed.
"These Infinity Relics were connected to your Life Force, eh? I was wondering how you were able to wield such power.
That’s quite an interesting way to use it."
He commented, seemingly impressed.
"Still, if the Relics were so deeply connected to you, doesn’t this mean their creator has complete absolute control over your life and death?
Why would you allow something like that?
And if your life was in their hands,
Why would you go against them?"
He questioned, unable to hide his curiosity.
And Zarveth...
He just lifted his head to stare at Nux and...
"You... You could have defeated me from the beginning...
Why extend the fight...?"
He questioned.
"Hmm.
That wasn’t the answer I wanted."
Nux just shrugged and—
"Whatever,
I guess I will find out on my own."
He spoke as he grabbed Zarveth’s head, lifted him in the air as if he was a trash bag, and suddenly, dense, dark energy surrounded Zarveth’s dying body.
It was time to devour one of the wisest Eternity Eternals.

chapters.title: Chapter 2112: I LOVE PLAYING WITH YOU!!!
paragraphs: "...huh? Where did he go? What did you do to him?"

Suddenly, Sharnoth, who had been constantly attacking Nux with everything she had, trying to free herself from his hold, suddenly blinked in surprise when she noticed she could no longer see Zarveth, who Nux was holding just now.

She only saw that dark energy that she did not understand cover Zarveth’s body. The Eternal was in no state to even move, let alone resist, and within a few seconds, the dark energy disappeared, together with him.
Almost as if it ate him, which didn’t make sense because she did not sense any destructive property from that energy.
"Hmm? Why do you ask?"
Nux questioned, curious.
"Because I liked him."
Sharnoth answered and suddenly—
Nux froze.
"...what did you say?"
He questioned, his golden eyes turning much sharper than they had been before throughout his battle with Zarveth.
"I liked him. Fighting him was fun! What did you do to him!?"
Sharnoth raised her voice, but this time...
"You... liked him?"
"Yes?"
Sharnoth tilted her head, confused as to why this man was making her repeat something so obvious, and Nux did not like that expression one bit.
’That bastard...’
He cursed in his head.
’He was trying to seduce my Sharnoth...’
His golden eyes became darker and darker.
’Good thing I didn’t kill him yet...’
He muttered. His mind was instantly clouded with far crueler thoughts than he was thinking before.
Zarveth...
He was truly pitiful.
And...
Sharnoth only made it worse.
"What did you do to him!?"
The woman shouted, looking concerned about her Toy who had disappeared, and Nux...
He glanced at the woman and—
"Fighting him was fun, eh...?"
He smiled.
A hollow, terrifying smile.
But...
"Yes!"
Sharnoth didn’t get any hint and just nodded excitedly.
Of course, Nux didn’t completely lose himself either. He came up with a better reply.
"Of course, fighting someone as weak as him would be fun for someone like you. After all, you wouldn’t have to put in that much effort, now would you?"
He then sighed dramatically,
"How very disappointing though—
To think you chose a weaker opponent and still lost.
You must be pitifully weak as well."
Nux shook his head, almost as if this wasn’t even worth it, and just as he expected—
"I am not weak!! And he wasn’t weak either!!"
Sharnoth countered.
"Hmm? He seemed pretty weak to me. Couldn’t even scratch me.
Maybe you both are weak?
It is no fun to play with the two of you. I’ll just go find a better playmate."
He shrugged as he let Sharnoth go and turned around, wanting to find a ’better playmate.’
"I am not weak!!!"
Sharnoth shouted. Hearing her words, Nux stopped as he slowly turned towards her and—
"Just look at your condition. You barely recovered from your fight with that weakling. What are you, if not weak?"
"I am not weak! I can still play!!"
She shouted as suddenly, the space around her twisted.

She increased the distance between the two of them, floating alone in this vast space. Her bloodied body trembled as waves of black-purple Chaos Energy pulsed from her. Her skin was already peeling off in patches, revealing the glowing shell of raw chaotic power beneath.
Then, a wild, twisted, unstable grin appeared on her face.
Her crimson eyes shimmered with lunacy.
"I’ll show you!"
She spoke.
"Since he is not here, I will play withyouinstead!"
She declared loudly, staring at Nux, who was now standing below her with a calm, untraceable smile on his face.
"You are notworthyof playing with me.
Go play with someone like Zarveth instead. He will suit you better.
You liked him for that reason, didn’t you?"
Nux just shrugged.
"NO!"
Sharnoth shook her head.
"I will play with you!"
She declared again as she prepared her attack.
To provoke her even further, Nux placed his right hand inside his pocket as he looked somewhere else, showing that he wasn’t interested in ’playing.’
The chaotic energy that gathered around him did not faze him even for a second.
"You’re not even serious..."
Sharnoth giggled.
"You’re still using just one hand, just like you did with him."
"The likes of you two are not enough for me to take you seriously.
I don’t need my second hand."
Nux teased again.
Sharnoth’s grin widened and—
"Then I’ll MAKE you need it."
She shot forward.

The Chaos Energy she gathered while having this conversation quickly surged around her. Her body became a whirlwind of destruction—claws, tendrils, serpents of shifting void. Dozens of her appeared in different spots, each throwing a different form of madness.
Explosions of sound.
Fire made of screams.
Time-stopping dust.
It was a storm of pure Chaos.
Nux didn’t even blink.
He stepped to the left.
Everything missed.
Sharnoth appeared behind him with a blade in her hand, trying to attack him, but—
Nux turned and—
Flick
He flicked her on the nose and her head snapped back.
"Ggkh—!"
She flew away, flipped in mid-air, stopped herself, and then laughed harder.
"You are strong!!"
"Of course I am. So go play with someone weak."
"NO!
Again! Again!! Do it again!!"
She launched herself at him. Chaos blades appeared from her spine. Her face cracked. Her jaw opened too wide, mouth glowing with raw energy.
Nux sidestepped and—
Flick
Another flick, this time to her cheek.
She spun wildly, flying backward.
"Stop dodging and fight me!"
She roared, forming two black balls of Chaos in her hands and throwing them at him.
They exploded—burning, freezing, shattering space.
But when the dust cleared...
Nux stood untouched.
"That was cute,"
He said with a smirk.
"Was that your strongest attack?"
Sharnoth screamed, pulling her hair out, ripping more of her skin away.
Energy exploded from her again.
"NO! I’M NOT DONE!!"
She flew at him, faster this time—claws reaching forward.
Nux ducked and flicked her forehead again.
She crashed into a floating asteroid that shattered on impact. The rubble floated everywhere.
Her body was bloodied, part of her skin hanging in strips.
Still, she stood up again.
"You’re enjoying this, aren’t you!?"
She questioned.
"I’d enjoy it more if you hit me even once,"
Nux replied with a bored look on his face.
Those words made Sharnoth’s face twist. She did not like that answer one bit.
She raised both hands, screamed something in a language even she didn’t understand, and a storm of Chaos rained down on Nux from above—razor winds, shifting gravity, collapsing space.
But—
Nux just vanished, appeared beside her and—
Flicked her ear.
She twitched, froze mid-air, and then exploded in laughter.
"Hahaha!! You’re so annoying! I LOVE IT!!
I LOVE PLAYING WITH YOU!!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2113: We will play again later.
paragraphs: "Hahaha!! You’re so annoying! I LOVE IT!!
I LOVE PLAYING WITH YOU!!!"
She raised her foot and tried to stomp him from above, turning her leg into a spiraling spear.
He caught it.
Spun her in mid-air like a ragdoll, then lightly tossed her across the battlefield.
She smashed through three layers of floating terrain before finally stopping.
Then...
She remained still for a moment.
Her breath was heavy.
Blood and Chaos leaked from her open wounds.
She looked at herself—half her skin already gone. Her legs and arms were peeled to the glowing bones of Chaos. Her chest was nearly exposed, the shell of Chaos underneath now seemed stable.
And slowly, the smile on her face returned—this time comparably softer than before.
"I am getting stronger..."
She whispered.

She reached for her face, tearing off another strip of skin. More power surged through her body, her partial domain started forming again, this time far stronger compared to when she was facing Zarveth.
"Meh, I don’t see it."
However, Nux just shrugged.
"I am not liking playing with you at all.
I want to leave."
He complained.
"You can’t leave!!"
"Why? I am not having fun. Why shouldn’t I leave? Would you continue playing if you were not having fun?"
"...I-I am getting better!"
She tried to defend herself.
"And I am telling you you aren’t."
"Meh, boooringgg~"
Nux simply turned around, ready to leave.
"You are running away!!"
Sharnoth tried to provoke him, but—
"Running? Sure, think like that if it makes you feel any better. I do not care either way."
Nux just continued walking. His right hand, that he never took out of his pocket, made it clear to Sharnoth that her words were not true.
"Go find someone else to play."
Nux raised his hand, waving her goodbye.
But then—
"You can’t leave!!
I want to play with you!!!"
She shouted, as she summoned six versions of herself—each twisted, monstrous, full of rage—and sent them all after Nux at once.
And he...
He just continued walking, not even looking at the attack.
Every version of her shattered on contact with his body, exploding into mist.
The real Sharnoth appeared above him, prepared to cut him in half with her sword, but Nux just grabbed her sword with two fingers and—
"Too weak."
He sighed.
"This is no Chaos energy.
This is just tantrum energy."
"SHUT UP!"
Sharnoth pulled another strip of skin off her back. More Chaos energy was released. She unleashed another wave of strong attacks, but again, Nux was unfazed.
The more she attacked, the more helpless she felt. Nux continued walking away from her while she continued to chase him with her deadly attacks. It was quite an amusing sight.
In her helplessness, Sharnoth peeled off more and more of her skin. The Chaos Energy around her practically doubled. Her partial Domain now felt like it was as strong as a real domain, but...
None of it mattered.
Nux’s body was simply too strong to get hurt by her attacks.
No matter what she did, no matter how desperately she tried, Nux continued walking away.
The battle continued for hours, but the result did not change. By the end of it—
Sharnoth hovered above the battlefield, her entire body trembling. Her skin was almost completely gone—arms, legs, back, stomach—all stripped away.
What remained underneath was not flesh.
It was pure Chaos.
A glowing, shifting mass of black-purple energy, veined with crimson and silver flashes, pulsing with raw, unfiltered madness.
Only one piece of skin remained now—right over her heart.
But...
She didn’t seem happy about it.
Even after all this...
Her attacks didn’t affect Nux one bit.
He was still walking away and...
She did not like it.
"Stop...
I want to... play with you..."
She called, her voice weaker than before. Even someone as crazy as her felt her confidence taking a hit.
But this time,
Nux stopped.
He finally turned around. All this while, he had been keeping an eye on her condition, making sure she completed her Body of Chaos and got stronger.
This was the reason he kept pushing her.
And now that she was close...
He decided to give her one final push.
"Do you really wish to play with me?"
He questioned.
"Yes!"
"I have a condition."
"What is it?"
"You can’t play with anyone else.
Not until you defeat me."
"OKAY!!"
Sharnoth nodded without hesitation.
With Nux’s possessive side finally calming down, he glanced at the woman in front of him and—
"Alright then,
Show me your strongest attack."
He spoke.
"Show me,
What you look like,
When you are at your strongest."
He demanded, and hearing those words, Sharnoth’s hovering crimson eyes shined intensely.
"YES!"
Her voice echoed throughout his universe. The last strip of her skin finally came off and—
BOOOOOOM
The explosion of energy that followed rippled across the entire universe. Space twisted, reality bent, and Nux felt his Universe react to something not connected to him for the first time.
Sharnoth’s body shined like a newborn star—no longer a person, but a living embodiment of Chaos.
She floated higher, almost endless power coursing through her body.
Yes,
The Body of Chaos was finally complete.
"HAHAHAHHA!!"
Sharnoth laughed.
Nux too, smiled lightly. Then, a cold look appeared on his face as he finally realized it.
"So that was his plan."
He muttered softly, as he then disappeared and appeared right in front of Sharnoth.
Standing calmly, one hand still in his coat pocket, the other reaching forward. Sharnoth tried to dodge, but she couldn’t.
Nux was simply too fast.
"W-What are yo—"
She tried to say something, but no words came to her. She was going to show him her strongest attack now that she had finally become strong, but why was he moving?
Was he... trying to dodge her attack?
Does he... finally think her attack is worth reacting to?
A grin appeared on Sharnoth’s face as she thought about it. Thinking she was finally strong enough for him to take her seriously, she tried to free herself from his hold, but...
She very quickly realized that no matter what she did,
It was useless.
It was just like before. Nux was simply too strong for her to be able to resist him.
Then suddenly, while resisting him, Sharnoth heard a voice—
"We will play again later."
And then—
She was devoured.

chapters.title: Chapter 2114: Body of Chaos
paragraphs: "W-What are yo—"

Sharnoth tried to resist. She grabbed Nux’s fingers with her hands and tried to move them, loosening his grip. She even thrashed her legs, continuously kicking him, trying to free herself from his hold. But just like before, no matter what she did,
It didn’t work.

It was as if she was struggling against an immovable object. No matter how much force she used, even after completing her Body of Chaos and using ALL the Chaos Energy around her to somehow affect this man or weaken him even a little, it just did not work.
The Chaos Energy she gathered around him simply moved away the moment it got in contact with him, almost as if she didn’t have any control over it.
Then suddenly, Sharnoth saw that same strange dark energy that erased the Toy King covering her as well, making her heart shudder.
Just thinking about how she wouldn’t be able to play anymore scared her. To think it was happening just when she had finally become stronger,
’NO!’
Sharnoth shouted inwardly. Her resistance became stronger as a ridiculous amount of Chaos Energy gathered around her, ready to protect her.
But then—
Whoosh
Something happened and to Sharnoth’s horror, the abundance of Chaos Energy around her... disappeared.
’What...?’

Her eyes widened in disbelief. She tried connecting with it again, but other than the Chaos Energy inside her body, she couldn’t sense any more Chaos Energy. It was almost as if it was erased from existence.
The woman slowly glanced at Nux, trying to understand what he was trying to do, but he just smiled and—
"We will play again later."
He chuckled softly, and before Sharnoth could ask anything further, the strange dark energy covered her entire body and she was enveloped in strange, empty darkness.
After Sharnoth disappeared, Nux stared at his ’domain’ in silence.
’...You actually devoured her.’
Felberta, who was watching everything happen with the rest of the women, muttered, somewhat surprised.

She knew it was going to happen eventually. She could already sense how attached Nux was to her, and Sharnoth wasn’t an exception. Maybe because she was grateful to him, or for any other reason, the Princess who rose from chains had become quite attached to Nux, even going as far as risking her life for his sake, even before she got the chance to take her revenge.
The women knew that if nothing completely out of expectations happened, Sharnoth would become one of them and be devoured eventually, but...
The reason Nux didn’t devour her all this while was because he wanted her to face Vexarion and get her revenge on her own.
Sure, with the movement of the Supreme Worlds, for a moment, it did seem like that wouldn’t be possible, but everything here was tidied up perfectly.

Since Zarveth didn’t want the information to spread, he had sealed the space, making sure no one knew what happened here. So even if Nux left Sharnoth, the Universe would only react to the disappearance of the Supreme Party that was sent to hunt down the ’Chain Breakers’.

It would have nothing to do with the Leander Family and the battle between Sharnoth and Vexarion. If everything went well, Sharnoth would have gotten a chance to bring down and end Vexarion with her own hands, something she wanted desperately.
Heck, it would have been even easier considering she had completed that physique of hers.
Felberta didn’t understand why Nux took this opportunity from her,
But—
’I had to.’
Nux answered.
’What...?’
Felberta’s expression changed.
’What do you mean?’
Vyriana questioned as well.
Aeliana narrowed her eyes as well—
’You mentioned ’his plan’ when Sharnoth completed her Body.
Who were you talking about? And what is this plan you seemed to be wary of?’
The Vampire narrowed her eyes.
She had her suspicions, of course, but it was still better to hear it from him.
Nux stayed silent for a moment, as if collecting his thoughts, then, he began,
’It is my dear father.’
’What did he do?’
Amaya questioned, narrowing her eyes.
’From Sharnoth’s memory, I knew he had done something to her body.’
’Yes, you mentioned that he changed her body affinity from Darkness to Chaos. He used some Chaos Crystal, I think...?’
Thyra nodded.
"That is correct."
Nux nodded at those words.
’But he didn’t just change her affinity.
He changed the very foundation. That Chaos Crystal he gave her, it was the foundation of his Physique—the Body of Chaos.
That physique was the reason Sharnoth became as strong as she is today.’
’What...?’
’Sharnoth was the daughter of one of the strongest Eternals in the Universe, and she too had the potential to become as strong as her father, but that was it.
That was the limit of Sharnoth Nocthys, the Daughter of Nocthys’s Sovereign. Her potential was nowhere near enough to reach the level she had reached, that too, in mere hundred thousand years.’
’Didn’t you say it happened because of Energy of Chaos?’
Skyla questioned with a frown.
This wasn’t the first time they were talking about Sharnoth. After Nux read her memories, the women had surrounded him to know more about her as well.
Even then, Nux raised this question.
Sharnoth’s growth was simply too fast and powerful when compared to the potential she was born with. At that time, he credited it to the Energy of Chaos and that father of his, but...
’I was wrong.’
Nux shook his head.
’She grew this much because Zylarith gave her his Physique. It changed her foundation, strengthening her potential, and it wasn’t just a simple boost. It made her Heir to Chaos.’
’Wait...’
The women’s expressions changed and Nux nodded.
’Yes, her potential became even stronger than the Supreme Borns. It was comparable to a Progenitor of a Supreme World.’
’That... doesn’t make sense...’
Vyriana frowned.
’Her growth was too slow if that was the case...’
Aeliana nodded as well.

She had heard stories about her father’s progress. Sure, her father’s potential was probably stronger than other Supreme World Progenitors, but still, Sharnoth’s speed was nowhere close to her father’s.
’Chaos is a complicated energy.’
Nux answered.
’She had to rise while hiding her existence, not to mention she was suppressing her true nature all the time. Adding other factors into this,
Her progress was actually quite fast.’
He clarified.
’So what was the end plan?’
Suddenly, Ember frowned.
’Did our dear father-in-law actually want to help her?’
She questioned sarcastically.
’Did he want her to be the new Chaos Progenitor?’
’No.’
Nux shook his head.
’Becoming an Infinity without a Supreme World is impossible. That is the limitation set by the Main Universe.’
’Then...’
’He wanted Sharnoth to complete the Body of Chaos.’
Nux revealed and the women’s expressions changed.
’Why is that?’
’The Body of Chaos...’
Nux paused for a moment, as if trying to find the easiest way to explain this—
’It is just as its name suggests, a body that is made of the purest form of Chaos.

A body that connects one with the Chaos Energy throughout the Universe. According to Zarveth’s memories, it was something Zylarith created on his own, something that made him the strongest to ever exist in the history of the Universe.’
The women blinked in surprise and Nux began explaining everything: the limitations of Chaos Progenitors, how Zylarith overcame everything, and the rest.
’The strongest being in the history of the Universe, huh...’
Aeliana muttered, and no matter how hard she tried, she couldn’t resist the urge to ask the next question in her mind,
’Was he...’
’I do not know.’
Nux shook his head.
’I have never seen Father-in-law using all his strength, but Zylarith...
From Zarveth’s memories, during the final battle between the Supreme World of Chaos and the other four Supreme Worlds, that monster took on Infinities of Light, Darkness, and Balance all on his own.
He was only defeated when the Eternity Infinity, who was an Eternal back then, broke through, became an Infinity, and attacked him from behind.
Four Infinities had to use all their strength to take down the monster called Zylarith Chaosveil.
He wasthatstrong.’
Nux answered and...
A heavy silence fell over the place.
Even Aeliana couldn’t confidently say that her father could take on four Infinities alone.
’...He was strong.’
Vyriana muttered with a grim look on her face.
’He reached that level because of the Body of Chaos.’
Nux answered,
’It allowed him to control all the Chaos Energy throughout the Universe, making his energy reserves pretty much endless.’
’And to think he gave this physique to Sharnoth...
He...
He truly wanted to raise her as his successor, huh...’
Vyriana muttered, but—
’No.’
Nux shook his head.
’What do you mean?’
The women frowned.
’As I said, the Body of Chaos is just... a physical manifestation of pure Chaos.’
’And?’
’Chaos is an energy.’
’So?’
The women frowned. Soon, however, their eyes widened in horror—
’Wait—’
And Nux nodded,
’An energy is manipulated by someone who understands it the most.
Who do you think understands Chaos better—Sharnoth Nocthys, Heir to Chaos, or Zylarith Chaosveil, the strongest Chaos Progenitor?’
’So Zylarith wanted her to complete the Body of Chaos because...’
’Because once she does that,
He would have complete control over her body, and Sharnoth would have no way to resist his control.
She would become a mere puppet who would do anything he wanted her to, even if she later broke through and became an Infinity.
Zylarith never held back when he taught her and gave her everything she needed to get stronger—not because he wanted her to succeed or get her revenge or whatever—
It was because he knew that no matter what happened or what Sharnoth did,
She would never be able to leave his control.’

Four Infinities had to use all their strength to take down the monster called Zylarith Chaosveil.
He wasthatstrong.’
Nux answered and...
A heavy silence fell over the place.
Even Aeliana couldn’t confidently say that her father could take on four Infinities alone.
’...He was strong.’
Vyriana muttered with a grim look on her face.
’He reached that level because of the Body of Chaos.’
Nux answered,
’It allowed him to control all the Chaos Energy throughout the Universe, making his energy reserves pretty much endless.’
’And to think he gave this physique to Sharnoth...
He...
He truly wanted to raise her as his successor, huh...’
Vyriana muttered, but—
’No.’
Nux shook his head.
’What do you mean?’
The women frowned.
’As I said, the Body of Chaos is just... a physical manifestation of pure Chaos.’
’And?’
’Chaos is an energy.’
’So?’
The women frowned.
Soon, however, their eyes widened in horror—
’Wait—’
And Nux nodded,
’An energy is manipulated by someone who understands it the most.
Who do you think understands Chaos better—Sharnoth Nocthys, Heir to Chaos, or Zylarith Chaosveil, the strongest Chaos Progenitor?’
’So Zylarith wanted her to complete the Body of Chaos because...’
’Because once she does that,
He would have complete control over her body, and Sharnoth would have no way to resist his control.
She would become a mere puppet who would do anything he wanted her to, even if she later broke through and became an Infinity.
Zylarith never held back when he taught her and gave her everything she needed to get stronger—not because he wanted her to succeed or get her revenge or whatever—
It was because he knew that no matter what happened or what Sharnoth did,
She would never be able to leave his control.’

chapters.title: Chapter 2115: Law of Absolute Growth
paragraphs: ’He knew that no matter what happened or what Sharnoth did—
She would never be able to leave his control.’
Nux spoke with a grim look on his face.
’And that is not even the worst part.’
’What does that mean?’
Felberta frowned.
’Since Zylarith would be taking control over Sharnoth’s body using his stronger comprehension of Chaos, Sharnoth’s own consciousness wouldn’t disappear either.’
’All the while Zylarith had complete control over her body, Sharnoth would have been conscious. She would be able to see, hear, touch, and feel everything she was doing or was happening to her.
She just... wouldn’t be able to do anything about it...
And this would have continued for... possibly forever.’
’...What?’
The women’s expressions changed.

They couldn’t help but imagine themselves in that situation, thinking about the feeling of helplessness they would have felt, trapped inside their own body, doing something they absolutely did not wish to do but unable to resist it...
It made them shiver in disgust.
’I knew he was up to no good.’
Vyriana muttered. She never liked that man from the moment she saw him, the way he talked about using them as tools to grow...
It was apparent that he never once considered them as living beings—no, perhaps he did—but in his mind, beings other than him simply did not matter.
’So the reason you devoured Sharnoth was so that you could protect her from Zylarith’s control, huh?’
Suddenly, Riona muttered and Nux nodded.
After a slight pause, Riona nodded,
’That makes sense. With the connection between Sharnoth and the Universe’s Chaos now severed, he would have no way to control her now.’
’That is incorrect.’
Nux shook his head.
’...What?’

’The energy of Chaos in our Universe comes from Sharnoth’s Law, which in itself comes from Zylarith’s teaching and the main Universe. There is no difference between our Universe’s and the main Universe’s Chaos.’
’Are you saying...’
’Because the origin of Chaos is the same, Zylarith can still control Sharnoth’s body even after I devoured her.’
’Then why did you...’
’I can take back that control.’
Nux answered.
’Hmm?’

’Yes, Zylarith can now take control over Sharnoth’s body, but she is also connected with me. Every time he takes control, since Sharnoth will be conscious, she can always talk to me and I can bring her back to our Universe, taking her away from Zylarith.
And of course, inside our Universe, I would have absolute control over Chaos—even if Zylarith’s comprehension of Chaos is stronger than mine—and I would be able to give the control back to Sharnoth.’
’Wait...’
Suddenly, Aeliana frowned.
’Are you saying you can control Sharnoth’s body as well?’
’As long as she is in our Universe, I can.’
Nux nodded.
’And she can never escape this Universe unless he wants her to.’
Shadow added with a playful laugh, and in an instant, the women turned silent.
Misunderstanding the long silence, Nux tried to explain himself,
’It wasn’t something I predicted, and I am not going to us—’
’Can you take control of my body as well?’
Amaya questioned out of the blue.
’Huh? Of course not.’
Nux answered and—
’Tsk.’
The Devourer snorted. Clearly, she wasn’t the least bit happy about it, and she wasn’t alone.
’Body of Chaos, huh...
So I need to create something like that.’

Edda muttered to herself, her mind constantly imagining different scenarios where Nux had complete control over her physical body while her mind was allowed tosee, hear, andfeeleverything that was happening to her.
Very quickly, her imagination became wilder and wilder and—
’Fufufu~
The new one’s quite lucky, eh?’
She grinned—a grin that made Nux’s spine tremble.

Of course, he would expect something like this from someone like Edda. The problem was how Aisha, Allura, Eisheth, and even Amaya, Aeliana, Lane, and Shadow had appeared next to her, thinking along the same lines.
’Girls...’
He tried calling out, but—
’We need to go meet her.’
Amaya shook her head as she then turned towards Shadow, who quickly moved everyone to where Sharnoth had appeared.
Nux and the rest of the women turned silent.
’A b-bunch of perverts!’
Lyriana snorted with a red face, and the women around her nodded continuously. It was quite an adorable sight that made Nux smile, but—
Suddenly, Felberta called out with a solemn look on her face.
’Hmm? What is it?’
Nux questioned.
’Sharnoth’s story... don’t you find it familiar?’
Felberta answered with slight hesitation.
’Hmm?’
Nux tilted his head in confusion, and the Eldraeth Progenitor continued in a low voice.
’She was picked when she was at her lowest. She was then given something that changed her destiny, making her potential much stronger than anyone around her...’
And suddenly—
Nux’s face changed.
’That Chaos Crystal... doesn’t it sound similar to... the System?’
Silence.
Complete silence fell over the place.
Not just the women here—even the women who had gone to Sharnoth—suddenly froze, and Nux was no different.
Was the System and the Chaos Crystal similar?
Of course not—they were fundamentally different, extremely different, actually.
But...
They did have a few things in common. They strengthened the wielder to the point where they easily reached a level they once thought was impossible—and went beyond it.
And... they were both created by Zylarith Chaosveil...

No, if one thought about it a little more carefully, there were quite a lot of similarities between the System and the Chaos Crystal. Heck, the System seemed like an advanced version of the Chaos Crystal.

After all, the Law of Absolute Growth—that was the core of the System—was constantly changing Nux’s body, just like the Chaos Crystal had changed Sharnoth’s body. Actually, the Law of Absolute Growth wasn’t just changing Nux’s body... it was affecting his wives as well.
’Create an army of millions of billions of women to overwhelm the Supreme Worlds.’
Suddenly, Nux recalled what Zylarith told him to do, and suddenly, his body trembled at his next line of thoughts.
Amaya called out with a grim look on her face.
The Devourer had reached the same conclusion as him. Not just her—the rest of the women could tell what everyone was thinking as well.
Every single one of them began examining their body, but no matter how much they tried, they couldn’t find anything.
’It is foolish to look.’
Suddenly, Riona shook her head.
’Even someone like Sharnoth failed to sense anything. If the System is something more advanced than the Chaos Crystal, then the chances of us noticing anything aren’t high.’
The women turned silent.
Nux remained silent as well. Even when he tried to inspect his own body, he didn’t sense anything.
’Of course, this could also all be us worrying excessively.’
Suddenly, Aeliana spoke with a reassuring smile on her face,
’Zylarith wanted Nux to only comprehend the Law of Absolute Growth, and according to his plan, the "army" of women around Nux shouldn’t have their own Laws either.
He simply wanted Nux to use the Law of Absolute Growth to push their cultivation and forcefully make them stronger—False Divines, Primordials, Transcendents, and so on.
But this did not happen.
Yes, the Law of Absolute Growth helped us—it strengthened our potentials—but unlike Sharnoth, it isn’t the root of our existence. Every single one of us has our own Laws.
Yes, the Law of Absolute Growth is connected to the Law of Chaos, but this doesn’t mean he would be able to take control over our bodies.
Especially not Nux’s. After all, the Law of Absolute Growth is just one of the Laws he has—it doesn’t even get close to defining his existence.
And as long as Nux is free of his control,
Just like Sharnoth,
We are safe as well.’
The Vampire theorized, and slowly, the women nodded. Those words were convincing. Nux’s existence was much more complicated than anything any being could comprehend.
Even if the said being was once hailed as the strongest being in history.

Nux nodded at those words as well. The Vampire’s theory was similar to his. This plan might have worked if he had followed the path the System had laid out for him, but right now, it didn’t make any sense.

Theoretically, Zylarith should never be able to take control over his body like he could with Sharnoth—and honestly, considering how that dear father of his had been reacting to his moves all this time,
It didn’t seem like things were under his control either.
From Zylarith’s actions, it seemed like he wanted Nux to come under him. Maybe there was still something he needed to do to take control over his body—maybe...
Like the Law of Chaos, the Law of Absolute Growth too has a physique of its own.
But...
Considering Nux’s current physique...
He found it hard to believe that a single Law could have that much effect on him.
"Alright, there is no point in thinking about it."
Suddenly, Nux just shrugged.
Then, he looked at his surroundings and closed his eyes. The shadow beneath his feet moved, covered his entire body before he disappeared.
And just as he did—
Crack
His domain cracked.
The crack continued to widen, and after about a minute later, the entire domain dematerialized, and when it happened—
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
THUNDER THUNDER THUNDER
The Universe reacted to the disappearance of two Eternals.
