chapters.title: Chapter 2145: sk, even your hypocrisy is boring.
paragraphs: "So they didn’t give out any warnings huh...
Was it because they wanted to take me by surprise when I attacked Aurendor?
Well, too bad for you I guess."
Nux shrugged and—
"AAAAAGGGGGGHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!"
Carlen, who was in his arms, screamed in agony, desperately moving his limbs trying to free himself from Nux’s grasp. He tried to kick him a few times to generate some force, but it was all useless.
The difference between their physical strength was simply too high.
Finally, a suffocating, threatening devouring mist started to creep onto Carlen’s body.
"A-AAAGGGGHHH!!! SAVE ME!! SAVE MEE!!"

He shouted, his eyes widening in sheer horror. In his current state, for some reason, his eyes fell on the woman from Greenmarch, the same woman he had just ’helped’. The woman was staring at him, frozen stiff, as if she couldn’t believe what was happening but...
Somehow, something inside her felt... good.
It was a feeling she couldn’t understand.
And she didn’t have the time to understand it either because—
"Let him go."
A deep, heavy voice was heard as a beautiful being appeared in the air, hovering above all, looking down on the rest of the world with a mighty look.
Nux raised his head, staring at the being.

A tall being with silver skin and hair, complete golden eyes with no irises and golden wings on his back. He was wearing a golden white robe that fluttered in the air, and there were two halos hovering over his head, reflecting a divine light that seemed to have a strong connection with every being present here.
He was a Seraphkin.
And from Carlen’s memories that he had devoured, Nux quickly recognized the man as well.
Silvaris Gracevale, one of the sixteen Eternals of Gracevale, also one of the Eternals who stayed in the Hall, making sure nothing out of the ordinary happened.
"I will not repeat myself."
Seeing that Nux still hadn’t done what he wanted, Silvaris repeated himself, his tone much colder now.
"Are you sure you alone will be enough?"
Nux questioned with a curious look on his face.
From his tone, he seemed calm, completely at ease.
But—
"L-LORD SILVARIS!! SAVE MEE!!!"
Carlen shouted. He could feel his life force being devoured by the mist, and seeing Silvaris’s appearance gave him a ray of hope he could desperately cling to.
Silvaris too, knew that he couldn’t waste time here. Although he didn’t particularly care about Carlen’s or anyone’s life, he still had to keep up an appearance.
So in the end—
He unleashed his domain.
A domain that spread far, instantly swallowing Nux and without wasting any time—
{Kneel}
Silvaris ordered.
And just like that—
Thud Thud Thud
With thuds, every being that was swallowed inside his domain together with Nux, knelt wherever they were, their heads bowed.
Yes, it was that easy.
Since an Eternal was Absolute in his Domain, his every command must be fulfilled, even if the being in question was an enemy or someone completely unrelated to the caster.
This was also the reason the Eternals were respected so much. If a being had no way to deal with an Eternal’s domain, they would end up as nothing but a puppet in their hands.
Or at least...
That is what should happen.
But...
"Am I supposed to wait for some fireworks now...?"
Nux questioned, still standing with Carlen in his hand, tilting his head in utter confusion.
And in an instant, every being present inside the domain widened their eyes in shock, especially Carlen. His shock was more of horror.
Even he, who was caught by the enemy, and his body, that was hovering in the air, was kneeling in the air itself. That was the effect of an Eternal’s domain—
Absolute Authority that takes complete control over one’s body.
But...
What was happening...?
Why wasn’t this man affected by an Eternal’s Domain!?
This made absolutely no sense!
It wasn’t just Carlen. Silvaris too, had a solemn look on his face as he stared at Nux. He was almost a billion years old, yet this was the first time he had seen something like this.
Even Eternals, if caught by an enemy’s domain by surprise, lose control over their body once the enemy wills it. This was one of the few ways to actually take down an Eternal but...
Never once, in his long life, had he seen a being completely ignore an Absolute authority without countering it with a Domain of his own.
Very quickly, Silvaris realized it.
This was dangerous.
Whoever this being was... he wasn’t someone he could take down easily.
He needed to be very, very careful.
And while Silvaris was being careful and thinking of a way to take down the enemy—
"AAAGGHHH!! LORD SIL—"
Carlen’s body was completely devoured by the Devouring Mist, erased from existence.
For a moment, a heavy silence fell in the surrounding.
This was Silvaris’s domain, a domain where endless golden light flowed everywhere, a domain where he had a godlike presence, but...
Inside this domain,
One being hovered in the air, attracting all the attention.
"Who are you?"
Silvaris questioned, staring at Nux. His tone lost quite a bit of his previous arrogance and strength.
"I asked you, didn’t I?
Let me repeat myself—
Are you sure you alone are enough?"
Nux repeated the same question with no change in his amused expression.
"Your indecisiveness and arrogance cost a life. As a follower of Light, a being who should value and protect life, I’d say it is quite a grave sin."
"You were the one who took his life."
Silvaris countered almost instantly.
Carlen losing his life didn’t really matter. The Universe was vast, billions of beings lost their life every single day.
It didn’t even affect the Universe much. After all, the life that disappeared returned to the Universe, only to return again in some other form.
This was how the Universe worked, everyone knew that.
But...
The loss of life couldn’t be blamed on him.
This, Silvaris couldn’t bear.
"Tsk, even your hypocrisy is boring."
Nux yawned as suddenly—
Pierce
A bloodied hand came out of Silvaris’s chest, making him widen his eyes in shock and horror—
"A new toy?
You better make this fun!"

paragraphs: Pierce
A bloodied hand came out of Silvaris’s chest, making him widen his eyes in shock and horror as he stared at it and then—
"A new toy?
You better make this fun!"
He heard an excited, crazy voice.

He slowly turned his head around and his eyes fell on a purple-black entity of pure energy who didn’t seem to have any skin containing the endless energy inside her. The only thing he could see were her crimson eyes and a big wide hollow grin that seemed like it was prepared to fully devour him.

Before Silvaris could realize it, the purple-black energy that entered his body through her hands began to mess with his insides. He tried to use his energy to forcefully push the purple-black energy out, but his control over his own energy became weaker.
"H-H-How are you m-moving...?"
He questioned in a hoarse voice, barely standing as he tried everything in his power to contain the endless energy that was ruining his body from the inside.
"Yo—"
He tried asking more questions, probably to buy some time but—
Pierce
A purple-black tentacle then pierced his hand which was about to use an artifact to call for reinforcements.
"Come on, stop with boring talks, let’s playyyy~"
Sharnoth spoke.
Pierce Pierce Pierce

And just as she did, more and more tentacles pierced Silvaris’s body, and Silvaris, who was barely fighting the Chaos Energy released inside his body by Sharnoth’s hand, was very quickly overwhelmed by the energy released by tens of tentacles.
Finally, his eyes began to lose their light. He couldn’t even raise his hand, let alone put up a fight. Even his domain had started to crack since he no longer had the energy to keep it up.
Just like that, one of the strongest beings in Gracevale was utterly defeated in a battle so one-sided that it was almost humiliating.
The rest of the beings who were swallowed inside Silvaris’s domain couldn’t believe what was happening.
Most of them from Lower Level Worlds, some were even from Lowest Level Worlds, they couldn’t even imagine the possibility of a being like Silvaris being defeated in such... pathetic manner.
And it wasn’t just them—

Silvaris too, had no clue what was happening or how it happened. According to the Universe’s rule, no one should be able to sneak behind him inside his domain, especially not when he had ’ordered’ every being inside his domain to kneel.
His enemies shouldn’t even be moving right now, let alone attacking him.
Yet here it was—
Two enemies, one who seemed completely unbothered by his domain, and another who snuck behind him and attacked till his domain no longer held any power.
It... it made absolutely no sense.
"Don’t think too much,
You will find out the answers to your questions soon enough."
Suddenly, Silvaris heard a voice.
It was Nux.
The man was now hovering right in front of him without any change in his expression.
"Now, just to be sure."

Nux then extended his hand, placing it on Silvaris’s forehead to read his memories. Carlen was a Transcendent and an important member of Gracevale Hall, but it didn’t mean he would know everything happening here or all the instructions passed down from above.
Silvaris, on the other hand, was different.
If the Supreme Worlds said anything about him, Silvaris would know.
But—
"Truly nothing huh..."
Nux muttered.
He couldn’t find anything.

The Supreme Worlds, or the Supreme Faction of Light that Silvaris had direct contact with, said nothing about his existence. The most recent Universal event according to them was still the disappearance of Umbrasol and the summon of all mercenaries’ world leaders.
"They must be really hoping for us to attack Aurendor huh..."
Nux muttered.
Sharnoth, who heard those words, reacted instantly.
"When are we attacking?"

She questioned, her crimson eyes shining dangerously. Unlike Sharnoth’s other personality, who only held hatred for Aurendor and Vexarion out of instinct, this one remembered it all—every single thing that happened from the day her Father was killed, to when she and her mother were captured by Aurendor.
It was all in her head.
Still as clear as if it all happened yesterday.
"Soon."
Nux smiled lightly.
Crack Crack Crack
Finally, Silvaris’s domain began to crack. Nux, who already knew from Silvaris’s memory that the rest of the fourteen Eternals were outside, started to stretch his body, preparing for the big battle.
"You will take care of him, is that clear?"
"But I want to play."
"Don’t you wish to play with Vexarion?"
Nux questioned and Sharnoth’s eyes changed.
"Be a good girl then."
The Devil muttered with a smile.
Sharnoth nodded and finally—
CRACK
The domain cracked completely as Sharnoth’s chaos energy ruined and destabilized the last bits of Silvaris’s energy inside his own body.
The golden light quickly broke down, revealing the familiar skies of Gracevale. The trapped beings thought they could finally move around and get away from this situation but...

The moment they stood up, their eyes fell on the fourteen Eternals that had now surrounded them and although not a single Eternal was looking at them, none of them were daring enough to actually try and leave this place.
Yes, their lives were in the hands of the Eternals.

The only hope they could cling to was the fact that they were inside Gracevale, a world that is known for peace and protection, so somewhere in their hearts, they were hoping they wouldn’t be implicated in the situation they had nothing to do with.
"Who are you? And why are you here?"
A being with white wings on his back, long golden hair and an ancient armor questioned with a grim look on his face as he stared at Nux.
As someone connected to Gracevale’s Will, the moment Carlen was attacked, he and the other Eternals were alerted that something was happening.
However, when they noticed that Silvaris had already made a move, they shrugged, thinking the situation was solved, especially when Silvaris created a domain and they didn’t sense a counter domain.
But...
The moment they sensed that Silvaris’s domain was destabilizing—things began to change.
Something was happening, and they all knew they needed to make a move.
They just...
Did not expect to see Silvaris, who was easily one of the strongest amongst the fifteen of them...
To be inthisstate.
Therefore, without thinking any further—
They tried to buy time and call reinforcements—
However—

chapters.title: Chapter 2147: Where is my Domain?
paragraphs: "Who are you? And why are you here?"
A being with white wings on his back, long golden hair, and ancient armor questioned with a grim look on his face as he stared at Nux.
His goal was clear, buy time and call for reinforcements because he knew this wasn’t a matter that would be easily solved, not when one of their strongest warriors was in that state.
Plus, the energy the entity standing behind this man was radiating...
Every single one of them could feel its uncontrolled, ruthless, and chaotic nature.
The Power of Chaos.
As few of the beings who had seen and experienced the Great War of the Five Supreme Worlds, they knew the significance that energy held.
This matter had to be reported to the Supreme World of Light.
But—
"Did you call for reinforcements already?"
Nux questioned, tilting his head with a grin.
"Who did you call? More Eternals? Or is it the Light Infinity?"
But before the man could answer, Nux just shrugged.
"Well, it doesn’t matter, really.
It is already over."
Saying those words,
The space around Nux grew still.
For a moment, it seemed like nothing was happening, confusing every Eternal that was here.
But then, the bright sky of Gracevale trembled, a slow, ridiculously powerful ripple was released from Nux’s body and with that—
The Reality itself split open.
The surroundings turned dark like a void, the boundaries of this domain continued to stretch further, expanding at a ridiculous rate.
And on its way, it started devouring everything—
The space, the time, the light, the darkness and... even the people.
The fourteen Eternals that had ’surrounded’ Nux, all panicked, finding themselves in a completely unfamiliar place.
Their bodies reacted on their own and they deployed their domains, wanting to counter whatever was happening to them.
But then something surprising happened.
Their domains were deployed but... there was no clash between their domains and Nux’s. It was as if... Nux’s domain simply swallowed theirs.
What’s worse?
The absolute-ness they usually felt after deploying their domain... they couldn’t feel it this time.

They looked around and noticed how their bright world, clear skies, beautiful buildings and everything they had built millions and millions of years ago, was all replaced by a void filled with faint stars created by Nux himself.
In panic, they brought out their artifacts that connected them to the Supreme World of Light, artifacts they were relying on to get the reinforcements but...
"W-What is happening...?"
"What...?"
"I-I am not getting any answers...
N-No, I-I can’t even send anything!"
"What!?"
The Eternals panicked, they all brought out their own artifacts but...
"I... I can’t connect either."
The result was the same.
The connection between their artifacts and the ’other side’ no longer existed.
The Eternals couldn’t believe it.
"Did he... somehow destroy our artifacts?"
"But... that isn’t possible...?
Lord Liran gave me this..."
They were shaken, in absolute disbelief.
However, this was just the beginning.
One of them raised their voice.
"Does any of you... feel a little different?"
He questioned as he stared at his comrades.
This was when the Eternals realized it.
Their connection with the Main Universe had snapped as well.
While they could still feel energies they were familiar with in this place, something about these energies felt... different.
The Eternals stared at each other, their shock, panic, and fear were clear on their faces.
As for the man responsible for all this?
"Welcome."
Nux smiled.
His voice now felt much heavier than before.
It came from all directions, as if the very place they were in was talking to them.
"...what did you do?"
One of the Eternals stepped forward and questioned.
"Think of it as a little experiment if you will."
Nux answered with a smile, like a gentleman he was.
"An experiment...?"
The Eternal blinked.
But Nux...
He ignored him.
His focus was somewhere else.
’Nux, the Universe reacted.’
Faustina informed.
’Already?’
Nux frowned.
’Yes, it reacted just now.’
The woman nodded.
’So it activates the moment I activate my domain, huh...’
Nux noted.
"Answer my question, what experiment?"
’What about Gracevale, what happened to it?’
Nux asked.
’Nothing.’
Faustina shook her head.
’According to Azriel, Gracevale is fine. The Universe is reacting because a total of fifteen Eternals have disappeared.’
’Is that so...’
Nux nodded to himself.
"I will not ask again, boy."
’So the moment I activate my domain, whatever my Domain swallows, the Universe sees it as me devouring it all huh?

Then where am I right now? I can sense that my domain isn’t actually connected to my Universe, this place is not a part of my Universe, I cannot sense Umbrasol or my wives from here, so it is definitely an independent space.
What about Gracevale, is my domain still there?’
Nux asked.

This is what usually happens as well, every time a Transcendent, or an Eternal activates their domain, the beings outside their domain can still see it. This was also one of the ways to define a Domain’s strength, seeing how big the radius of its sphere is.
But—
’No.’
Faustina shook her head again.
’Azriel, using his Authority as the Universe’s child, went to Gracevale and he isn’t sensing anything wrong.

Gracevale is panicking because it has lost its connection with all its Eternals, the same is true for the people, they all saw a man appear, how the Eternals surrounded him, but then suddenly, the man formed his domain and the instant the domain devoured the Eternals, they all disappeared and everything else returned to normal.
Well, if you consider Gracevale and the Universe trembling in panic and anger ’normal,’ that is.’
Faustina explained clearly and hearing her words...
Nux just blinked.
’So my domain does not exist in Gracevale either...?’
He asked.
’Yes.’
His mother nodded.
And Nux...
’Then where is it? My domain, I mean.
Where... am I...?’
He questioned, utterly confused.
But...
’We do not know.’
Faustina shook her head and then—
"I TOLD YOU TO ANSWER MY QUESTION!!"

The Eternal blinked.
But Nux...
He ignored him.
His focus was somewhere else.
’Nux, the Universe reacted.’
Faustina informed.
’Already?’
Nux frowned.
’Yes, it reacted just now.’
The woman nodded.
’So it activates the moment I activate my domain, huh...’
Nux noted.
"Answer my question, what experiment?"
’What about Gracevale, what happened to it?’
Nux asked.
’Nothing.’
Faustina shook her head.
’According to Azriel, Gracevale is fine.
The Universe is reacting because a total of fifteen Eternals have disappeared.’
’Is that so...’
Nux nodded to himself.
"I will not ask again, boy."
’So the moment I activate my domain, whatever my Domain swallows, the Universe sees it as me devouring it all huh?
Then where am I right now?
I can sense that my domain isn’t actually connected to my Universe, this place is not a part of my Universe, I cannot sense Umbrasol or my wives from here, so it is definitely an independent space.
What about Gracevale, is my domain still there?’
Nux asked.
This is what usually happens as well, every time a Transcendent, or an Eternal activates their domain, the beings outside their domain can still see it.
This was also one of the ways to define a Domain’s strength, seeing how big the radius of its sphere is.
But—
’No.’
Faustina shook her head again.
’Azriel, using his Authority as the Universe’s child, went to Gracevale and he isn’t sensing anything wrong.

Gracevale is panicking because it has lost its connection with all its Eternals, the same is true for the people, they all saw a man appear, how the Eternals surrounded him, but then suddenly, the man formed his domain and the instant the domain devoured the Eternals, they all disappeared and everything else returned to normal.
Well, if you consider Gracevale and the Universe trembling in panic and anger ’normal,’ that is.’
Faustina explained clearly and hearing her words...
Nux just blinked.
’So my domain does not exist in Gracevale either...?’
He asked.
’Yes.’
His mother nodded.
And Nux...
’Then where is it?
My domain, I mean.
Where... am I...?’
He questioned, utterly confused.
But...
’We do not know.’
Faustina shook her head and then—
"I TOLD YOU TO ANSWER MY QUESTION!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2148: Varana Gracevale
paragraphs: Varana Gracevale, a man with beautiful long blond hair, a face that seemed sculpted to perfection, a large, strong build, and big white wings on his back that felt like proof of his purity and grace.
He was called one of the fastest Eternals in the Universe, a being well known and respected, not just in Gracevale, but in the entirety of the Light Faction.
It wouldn’t be wrong to call him the face of Gracevale.
A man with many grand titles.
The Harbinger of Peace.
The Strongest of Gracevale.
The Fastest.
The Light of Gracevale.
The Auriel of People.
Even the beings from Supreme Worlds, who acted arrogantly and dismissed anyone they did not like, respected him to some extent.
A man who attracted attention no matter where he went,
And yet...
Today...
Today, for the very first time in his long existence, Varana felt what it was like to be... dismissed, to go... unnoticed.
"What did you do...?"
That was his first question as he stared at the unknown man who had taken him and his men to this unknown, unsettling place.
The man then looked at him and smiled,
"Think of it as a little experiment if you will."
"An experiment...?"
Varana blinked, wanting to know more.
And that was where it started.
After answering his first question, the man ignored him, as if his words did not matter.
"Answer my question, what experiment?"
He asked again, this time, his voice carrying a little more weight but—
Nothing.
The man simply stared at an empty space with his expressions changing with time, it looked like he was having a conversation with someone else, when Varana was standing right in front of him.
Seeing that, Varana lost control over his temper.
"I will not ask again, boy."
He said, barely holding himself back.
But it didn’t matter, it almost seemed like the man couldn’t even see him, let alone hear his words.
And this was when Varana truly lost it.
"I TOLD YOU TO ANSWER MY QUESTION!!"
He shouted and just then, he disappeared.
The Gracevale’s strongest had decided.

Yes, the situation was full of uncertainties, this was an enemy they knew nothing about, too many strange things that didn’t make any sense had already happened, the best course of action here was to call and wait for reinforcements but...
Since it didn’t seem like that was going to work.
Varana knew it was time to take action.
And this was when he moved.

In battles at his level, the one who makes the first move has the advantage, not just that, the numbers were on his side as well, the enemy might have some unsettling means, but in the end, if they went all out, this wasn’t a battle they would lose.
Especially if he, using his speed that surprised even the Supreme Worlds, made the first move, took the enemy by surprise and did significant damage.
His aim?
It was to slice his neck using his blade, even if the enemy reacted at the last moment, Varana was sure he would get something out of this exchange.
He was confident in his speed that had given him an advantage in so many situations.
But this time—
"DIEE—"
Something different happened.
Something completely out of his expectation.
Varana, and the Eternals who were on his side and had barely reacted to his movements, all stared at the result of his ’surprise’ attack with shocked looks on their faces.
"H-How?"
Varana stuttered, seeing how his sword, which he thought was going to cut off the enemy’s head, was stopped by the enemy’s finger.
What’s worse?
After the initial eye contact when he answered his first question, the enemy never once looked at him.
Even now, when he had stopped his ’surprise’ attack with a mere finger, the enemy looked like he was still busy talking to someone else.
This...
This was humiliating.
Varana couldn’t believe it.
Soon however, his shock turned into anger and—
"AAAGGGGGHHH!!!"
He shouted, moving his sword away, this time targeting Nux’s left leg, where his finger couldn’t reach, but—
Nux simply moved his feet away, dodging his attack like it was nothing.
Varana glared at him in anger, his face deforming into something his people had never seen before, all his previous grace and purity was nowhere to be seen.
"DIE! DIE! DIE!!"
He screamed, swinging his sword like a madman.

He did everything in his power, he attacked limbs, areas difficult to dodge, he even used his speed to disappear and attack from a different angle, he used his energy to suppress the enemy’s movements, he tried to use his domain’s authority to keep the enemy still, he did every single thing he could think of—
But—
The result didn’t change.
From the start of the exchange to this point—
Nux simply dodged or blocked his attacks as if they were nothing, even now, when he had given his all, the man did not look at him.
Varana, Gracevale’s strongest, wasn’t even being seen as a hindrance, let alone an enemy to be taken seriously.
And this...
This fueled Varana with intense anger, emotions he had never felt before.
He turned towards his comrades, his eyes red in rage—
"WHAT ARE YOU STANDING THERE FOR!?!?
ATTACK HIM!!
ATTACK HIM TOGETHER!!"
He commanded.
The rest of the Eternals finally came out of their reverie.
The group didn’t even care about Sharnoth, who was standing behind, holding Silvaris in her hands, and directly pounced on Nux, ready to tear him apart.
Sure, he was capable enough to dodge and block if one Eternal attacked him alone but...
What if fourteen Eternals attacked him all at the same time?
There was no way he could dodge.
Or at least, that is what the Gracevale Progenitors thought—
But—
The moment they all released their energies in order to suppress Nux and attack him all at the same time—
Nux finally turned towards them and—
"Do you not see I am busy?
Or do you want me to make an example out of the useless ones?"
He questioned as he appeared in front of Varana, grabbed him by his head and...
"AAAAGGGGGHHHHHHHHHH—"
Tear
He tore his body into two equal parts, throwing it away like it was nothing more than trash.
"Be good,
Or you will all end up like him."

chapters.title: Chapter 2149: What do you want?
paragraphs: "Do you not see I am busy?
Or do you want me to make an example out of the useless one first?"
Nux questioned as he appeared in front of Varana, extended his hand, and grabbed him by his head.
Varana widened his eyes in disbelief.
He...
He couldn’t react to how fast the enemy was.
As one of the fastest beings in the Universe, his reaction speed was obviously much better than most, and while his eyes did manage to see Nux’s move...
His body...
It couldn’t react at all.
Even at the last millisecond, when he tried to move away and dodge—he failed.
Panicked, Varana released a huge amount of energy, trying to push Nux away from him. He grabbed Nux’s arm with both his hands, wanting to crush it and move it away, but...
Nux’s arm did not budge.
Even worse—the man simply ignored his struggles, brought his other hand closer, now holding Varana’s head with both his hands.
For a moment, Varana was confused.
Just...
What was he trying to do?
He wondered in his head, but then suddenly, his eyes widened in absolute fear as he felt his head being pulled in two different directions.
"N-No."

He stuttered, his face showing absolute fear as he sensed death right at the door. He tried to move, he tried to kick Nux, wanting to push him away and free himself, his wings fluttered desperately, trying to push his own body away from Nux but...
It was already too late.
Before he could do anything, the pain he felt in his head became much, much stronger, rising to a ridiculous level in milliseconds.
"AAAAGGGGGHHHHHHHHHH—"
Varana screamed in sheer terror and agony, trying to call for help or do just anything that might let him live, but finally—
Tear
Under the strong pull, his muscles, bones, skin, and everything that was keeping his body together—

It tore, and his head was separated into two pieces, and as if that wasn’t enough, Nux continued to pull his body apart. From head, to torso, to his legs, Varana’s entire body was ripped into two pieces and then—
Thud Thud
With a casual shrug, Nux dropped Varana’s ripped body on the ground as if it was nothing more than trash.
A second.
That was how long this entire exchange lasted.
It was so quick that by the time the rest of Gracevale’s Eternals recovered from their shock, suppressed their fear, and forced themselves to prepare and attack in order to save Varana...
Varana’s body was... already on the ground, torn into two equal pieces.
Silence.
Absolute silence fell over the place.
The Eternals stared at Nux, terrified.
If they had any doubts before, now it was clear.
They couldn’t win.
There was absolutely no way they could win against this monster.
Just...
Just who was he?
Why had they never heard of him before...?
Such questions began appearing in their heads as they stayed still. They didn’t even dare to think about avenging their brother.
They couldn’t. It was impossible, not when they were up against this monster without any backup whatsoever.
And finally,
Nux raised his head, staring at the thirteen remaining Eternals hovering in the air in front of him.
The Eternals felt their bodies flinch, and Nux—
"Be good."

He spoke. This time, even though his tone wasn’t particularly different from before, to the Eternals, it sounded as if it were the instructions of a Divine Entity that they could not confront or go against.
"Or you will all end up like him."
Nux threatened, and every single Eternal, beings who ruled over trillions, stayed silent, following his words like the good little children they were.
As for Nux, he looked away and continued his conversation again—
’You do not know?’
He frowned.
’No.’
Faustina shook her head.
Nux stayed silent for a while and then—
’I need to see what happened in Gracevale with my own eyes.’
He spoke.
And as if expecting that—
’You can.’
Another voice was heard.
It was Melia.
Nux frowned, he quickly connected with his Universe, seeing what Melia was doing, and the moment his eyes fell on her, he saw her holding a familiar woman by her neck.
The daughter of the Greenmarch Patriarch—the woman who was ahead of him in the line and was forced to submit Greenmarch to the Order of Light.
The woman was unconscious, and Melia, she shook her unconscious body as if she was showing it to Nux and—
"I thought you might need an outsider’s perspective to understand things better, so I grabbed her during the chaos when everyone was panicking."
The vampire answered out loud, knowing that Nux could hear her.
And Nux...
He stared at his wife and chuckled softly,
"You know me so well, my love~"
He spoke with a grin.
Melia nodded back, she outwardly acted like it was no big deal, but the rest of the women, who were staring at her with narrowed eyes, could see that the woman’s pale face had gotten redder.
She was definitely planning something.
"Alright, I’ll be there in a second."
Nux decided. Melia nodded, and Nux turned back towards the Eternals who were now in his grasp.
Admittedly, killing Varana was not in his plan, he just thought it was the fastest way to ensure these people act well, but Nux knew it wasn’t something he should have done.
’Setting an example’ like this wasn’t cost-effective, especially when the said cost was one of the strongest Eternals in the world.
’I am making such mistakes more often these days.’
Nux muttered to himself until finally, he shrugged as he convinced himself that there was no point in thinking about it now and that he needed to be more careful in the future.
He then stared at the Eternals in front of him and—
"I do not plan to kill you."
He began.
The Eternals stared at each other before finally, one of them stepped forward and—
"What do you want?"

chapters.title: Chapter 2150: That is something she would do.
paragraphs: "I do not plan to kill you."
Nux spoke as he glanced at the Eternals.
Of course, considering what he had just done a minute ago, his words weren’t very convincing—especially when the Eternals had tried to attack Nux just like Varana did.
But...
The Eternals did not have a choice either.
The enemy was strong, much, much stronger than what they were expecting and...
All their communication channels had failed. They tried again and again, but they failed to communicate with anyone outside of this... place.
Even the Artifacts given to them by the Supreme Borns weren’t working, so hoping that reinforcements would arrive for their sake was a foolish hope as well.
In the end, there were only two paths ahead of them.
Either follow this man’s words or...
Die, possibly in a way even more brutal than Varana.
The Eternals stared at each other, communicating with their eyes. It was clear that every single one of them wanted the same thing, so finally, one of them—a Luminari—stepped forward and—
"What do you want?"
She questioned.
Yes, the Eternals had decided to live.
After all, if they played their cards right, they might learn more about this place they were in, a way to leave and contact the outside world, and somehow come out of this situation alive.
"Absolute loyalty."
Nux answered the Luminari’s question. The woman’s eyes flickered at those words.
"Absolute loyalty? Loyalty for what?"
"I want you to submit to me.
That is the only way you live."
"But we have submitted to the Supreme World of Light."
The woman answered.
"Is your loyalty to the Supreme World of Light stronger than your will to live?"
Nux asked.

It was a direct threat—something that made the woman somewhat uncomfortable, not because she was threatened, but because she saw how... unbothered this man was when she mentioned the Supreme World of Light.
No matter what, the Supreme World of Light was... a Supreme World—one of the strongest worlds in the Universe, an absolute power that no being could go against.
Even the entities from other Supreme Worlds hesitated a little when she mentioned the Supreme World of Light in front of them, but...
A reaction like this was...
It was the first time she had seen something like this.
"You didn’t answer my question."
Nux commented.
The woman flinched at those words. She stared ahead, at the place where Nux should be, but her instincts screamed in terror when she didn’t see him there.
Suddenly, she felt a hand on top of her head, and in that very instant, all thoughts of resistance, loyalty, and thinking of a way to get out of this situation went out of her head and—
"It is not! It is not!"
She shouted, her eyes wide in horror as she stared at Nux, whose hand was on top of her head. Her quickened breathing showed just what the woman felt in that little instant.
Impressed by her quick reaction and ability to adapt, Nux nodded to himself, satisfied.
"Then are you ready to submit?"
"I am."
The woman nodded; she made sure her eyes showed absolutely no hesitation.
Nux nodded again, then he turned towards the rest and—
"What about the rest of you?"
"We... we are willing to submit as well."
One Seraphkin spoke, and the rest of the Eternals nodded behind him.
"Good."
Nux praised as suddenly, a foreign, dark mist came out of his hand and quickly surrounded the Luminari’s body.
The Luminari panicked, not knowing what she was supposed to do here, but then—
"Calm down.
As I said, I do not plan to kill you."
Nux’s words calmed her.
Even though the black mist felt threatening, something that might rewrite her very existence as she knew it, she... she stayed calm, just like Nux told her to.
She had no clue why the words of someone she met not long ago had such a strong effect on her. With some hesitation, she stared at Nux’s face and this time...
Something in her changed.
...Submitting to him might not be the worst thing that happened to her.
With that thought in her mind, the woman closed her eyes, showing her complete submission.
Yes, she wasn’t just submitting out of fear alone.
With that, the black mist completely surrounded the woman’s body, and when it disappeared, it took the woman with it.
Seeing the woman’s sudden disappearance, the rest of the Eternals widened their eyes, panicking a little.
"Don’t worry, I have just sent her to another dimension. A place you all will be going as well."
Nux spoke. His words made the rest of the Eternals tense.
They obviously had doubts in their heads—what if he was lying? What if they weren’t going to another dimension but being erased from existence itself?
After all, none of them sensed the Space Laws being activated. How could this man connect them to another dimension without using the Space Laws?
Of course, all these questions were just that—questions.
None of them dared to say them out loud.

Nux slowly walked towards them, and one by one, he continued devouring the Eternals until finally, he appeared in front of the unconscious Silvaris, whom Sharnoth—who had returned to her normal appearance—was holding using her energy, and he devoured him as well.
"Fourteen Eternals. It sure was a plentiful harvest."
Sharnoth commented with a smile.
"You returned to normal."
Nux tilted his head, a little confused, and Sharnoth shrugged.
"Shesaid she was bored since there was no one to play with, so she let me have the control."
Sharnoth answered.
"So you can now actively communicate with her, huh?"
Nux raised his eyebrow; he did not think it would happen this quickly.
"Not all the time."
Sharnoth shook her head.
"But yes, we can now switch when we wish, of course, that is if one is willing to give the control to the other.
For now, we have decided that she will do all the fights, while I take care of the rest."
"So she is leaving all the boring stuff to you."
Nux laughed.
"That is something she would do."
"Indeed."
Sharnoth chuckled as well.
"But I do believe that it is the best arrangement for us. I would rather have her fight and have fun than... talk."
"Hahaha~"
Nux laughed at those words and nodded.
"Indeed, indeed."

sentences.text: "I do not plan to kill you."
Nux spoke as he glanced at the Eternals.
Of course, considering what he had just done a minute ago, his words weren’t very convincing—especially when the Eternals had tried to attack Nux just like Varana did.
But...
The Eternals did not have a choice either.
The enemy was strong, much, much stronger than what they were expecting and...
All their communication channels had failed.
They tried again and again, but they failed to communicate with anyone outside of this... place.
Even the Artifacts given to them by the Supreme Borns weren’t working, so hoping that reinforcements would arrive for their sake was a foolish hope as well.
In the end, there were only two paths ahead of them.
Either follow this man’s words or...
Die, possibly in a way even more brutal than Varana.
The Eternals stared at each other, communicating with their eyes.
It was clear that every single one of them wanted the same thing, so finally, one of them—a Luminari—stepped forward and—
"What do you want?"
She questioned.
Yes, the Eternals had decided to live.
After all, if they played their cards right, they might learn more about this place they were in, a way to leave and contact the outside world, and somehow come out of this situation alive.
"Absolute loyalty."
Nux answered the Luminari’s question.
The woman’s eyes flickered at those words.
"Absolute loyalty?
Loyalty for what?"
"I want you to submit to me.
That is the only way you live."
"But we have submitted to the Supreme World of Light."
The woman answered.
"Is your loyalty to the Supreme World of Light stronger than your will to live?"
Nux asked.

It was a direct threat—something that made the woman somewhat uncomfortable, not because she was threatened, but because she saw how... unbothered this man was when she mentioned the Supreme World of Light.
No matter what, the Supreme World of Light was... a Supreme World—one of the strongest worlds in the Universe, an absolute power that no being could go against.
Even the entities from other Supreme Worlds hesitated a little when she mentioned the Supreme World of Light in front of them, but...
A reaction like this was...
It was the first time she had seen something like this.
"You didn’t answer my question."
Nux commented.
The woman flinched at those words.
She stared ahead, at the place where Nux should be, but her instincts screamed in terror when she didn’t see him there.
Suddenly, she felt a hand on top of her head, and in that very instant, all thoughts of resistance, loyalty, and thinking of a way to get out of this situation went out of her head and—
"It is not!
It is not!"
She shouted, her eyes wide in horror as she stared at Nux, whose hand was on top of her head.
Her quickened breathing showed just what the woman felt in that little instant.
Impressed by her quick reaction and ability to adapt, Nux nodded to himself, satisfied.
"Then are you ready to submit?"
"I am."
The woman nodded; she made sure her eyes showed absolutely no hesitation.
Nux nodded again, then he turned towards the rest and—
"What about the rest of you?"
"We... we are willing to submit as well."
One Seraphkin spoke, and the rest of the Eternals nodded behind him.
"Good."
Nux praised as suddenly, a foreign, dark mist came out of his hand and quickly surrounded the Luminari’s body.
The Luminari panicked, not knowing what she was supposed to do here, but then—
"Calm down.
As I said, I do not plan to kill you."
Nux’s words calmed her.
Even though the black mist felt threatening, something that might rewrite her very existence as she knew it, she... she stayed calm, just like Nux told her to.
She had no clue why the words of someone she met not long ago had such a strong effect on her.
With some hesitation, she stared at Nux’s face and this time...
Something in her changed.
...Submitting to him might not be the worst thing that happened to her.
With that thought in her mind, the woman closed her eyes, showing her complete submission.
Yes, she wasn’t just submitting out of fear alone.
With that, the black mist completely surrounded the woman’s body, and when it disappeared, it took the woman with it.
Seeing the woman’s sudden disappearance, the rest of the Eternals widened their eyes, panicking a little.
"Don’t worry, I have just sent her to another dimension.
A place you all will be going as well."
Nux spoke.
